  function b64ToBytesPdfjs(b64){
    const binary = atob(b64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++) bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }
  class EmbeddedCMapReaderFactory {
    constructor(opts) {}
    async fetch({name}) {
      const data = EMBEDDED_CMAPS[name];
      if(!data) throw new Error('CMap not found (embedded): ' + name);
      return { cMapData: b64ToBytesPdfjs(data), compressionType: 1 };
    }
  }
  class EmbeddedStandardFontDataFactory {
    constructor(opts) {}
    async fetch({filename}) {
      const data = EMBEDDED_STD_FONTS[filename];
      if(!data) throw new Error('Standard font not found (embedded): ' + filename);
      return b64ToBytesPdfjs(data);
    }
  }
  const PDFJS_DOC_OPTS = {
    CMapReaderFactory: EmbeddedCMapReaderFactory,

  // Google Drive連携はGoogle公式のOAuth認証で直接Drive APIを呼び出す方式
  const GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = '641615419218-d7cv1vaup68lvs8hmt57dv2lgd53sb2q.apps.googleusercontent.com';
  const GOOGLE_DRIVE_SCOPE = 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive';
  let googleAccessToken = null;
  let googleTokenExpiresAt = 0;
  let googleTokenClient = null;

  function getGoogleTokenClient(){
    if(googleTokenClient) return googleTokenClient;
    if(!window.google || !google.accounts || !google.accounts.oauth2){
      throw new Error('Google認証ライブラリを読み込めませんでした。ページを再読み込みしてください。');
    }
    googleTokenClient = google.accounts.oauth2.initTokenClient({
      client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
      scope: GOOGLE_DRIVE_SCOPE,
      callback: () => {},
    });
    return googleTokenClient;
  }

  function ensureGoogleAuth(forcePrompt=false){
    return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
      if(!forcePrompt && googleAccessToken && Date.now() < googleTokenExpiresAt - 60000){
        resolve(googleAccessToken); return;
      }
      try{
        const client = getGoogleTokenClient();
        client.callback = (resp)=>{
          if(resp.error){ reject(new Error('Google認証に失敗しました: '+resp.error)); return; }
          googleAccessToken = resp.access_token;
          googleTokenExpiresAt = Date.now() + (resp.expires_in||3600)*1000;
          renderDriveAuthStatus();
          resolve(googleAccessToken);
        };
        client.requestAccessToken({prompt: forcePrompt ? 'consent' : ''});
      }catch(e){ reject(e); }
    });
  }

  function renderDriveAuthStatus(){
    const el = document.getElementById('drive-auth-status');
    if(!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = (googleAccessToken && Date.now() < googleTokenExpiresAt)
      ? '<span style="color:#065f46"><i class="ti ti-circle-check"></i> Googleに接続済み</span>'
      : '<span style="color:#9ca3af"><i class="ti ti-circle-dashed"></i> 未接続</span>';
  }

  async function connectGoogleDrive(){
    try{
      await ensureGoogleAuth(true);
      showToast('✅ Googleドライブに接続しました');
    }catch(e){
      alert('Google接続に失敗しました: '+e.message);
    }
  }

  async function driveApiFetch(url, opts={}){
    const token = await ensureGoogleAuth();
    const headers = Object.assign({}, opts.headers||{}, {Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`});
    let resp = await fetch(url, Object.assign({}, opts, {headers}));
    if(resp.status===401){
      const token2 = await ensureGoogleAuth(true);
      const headers2 = Object.assign({}, opts.headers||{}, {Authorization: `Bearer ${token2}`});
      resp = await fetch(url, Object.assign({}, opts, {headers: headers2}));
    }
    return resp;
  }

  // 指定フォルダ直下のサブフォルダIDを1件分だけ取得（内部ヘルパー）
  async function listDriveSubfoldersOneLevel(folderId){
    const q = `'${folderId}' in parents and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed=false`;
    const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&fields=files(id,name)&pageSize=100&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true&corpora=allDrives`;
    const resp = await driveApiFetch(url);
    if(!resp.ok) return [];
    const data = await resp.json();
    return (data.files||[]).map(f=>f.id);
  }

  // 指定フォルダ配下のサブフォルダを、階層の深さに関わらずすべて取得する
  async function listDriveSubfolders(folderId){
    const visited = new Set([folderId]);
    const result = [];
    let queue = [folderId];
    while(queue.length){
      const nextQueue = [];
      for(const id of queue){
        const subs = await listDriveSubfoldersOneLevel(id);
        for(const subId of subs){
          if(!visited.has(subId)){
            visited.add(subId);
            result.push(subId);
            nextQueue.push(subId);
          }
        }
      }
      queue = nextQueue;
    }
    return result;
  }

  // 複数ページ（連続とは限らない）を抜き出して1つのPDFにまとめる
  async function extractPagesBytes(srcBytes, pageIndices){
    try{
      const PDFDocument = PDFLib.PDFDocument;
      const srcDoc = await PDFDocument.load(srcBytes);
      const newDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
      const copied = await newDoc.copyPages(srcDoc, pageIndices);
      copied.forEach(p=>newDoc.addPage(p));
      return await newDoc.save();
    }catch(e){
      console.warn('extractPagesBytes error:', e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function dbSaveRecord(rec) {
    const row = recordToRow(rec);
    let payload = Object.assign({}, row);
    let error;
    // 存在しない列がある環境でも、他の項目が保存できるよう
    // 列不足エラーが出た場合は該当列を除いて自動的に再試行する（最大5回）
    for(let attempt=0; attempt<5; attempt++){
      const result = await db.from('documents').upsert(payload, {onConflict:'id'});
      error = result.error;
      if(!error) break;
      const m = /column "?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"? of relation|Could not find the '([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)' column/i.exec(error.message||'');
      const missingCol = m && (m[1]||m[2]);
      if(missingCol && missingCol in payload){
        console.warn(`Supabaseのdocumentsテーブルに ${missingCol} 列が無いため、この項目は保存されませんでした。`);
        delete payload[missingCol];
        continue;
      }
      break;
    }
    if(error) console.error('dbSaveRecord error:', error);
    return !error;
  }

  async function dbSaveHistory(docId, histItem) {
    const { error } = await db.from('document_histories').insert({
      document_id: docId,
      history_type: histItem.type,
      detail: histItem.detail,
      occurred_at: histItem.at,
    });
    if(error) console.error('dbSaveHistory error:', error);
  }

  async function dbLoadAll() {
    showToast('☁️ データを読み込み中...');
    const { data: docs, error: e1 } = await db.from('documents').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:false});
    if(e1) { console.error('dbLoadAll docs error:', e1); showToast('⚠️ データ読み込みエラー'); return; }
    const { data: hists, error: e2 } = await db.from('document_histories').select('*').order('occurred_at',{ascending:true});
    const { data: asgns } = await db.from('assignees').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:true});
    const { data: usrs } = await db.from('users').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:true});
    const { data: dtypes, error: e3 } = await db.from('doc_types').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:true});
    records = (docs||[]).map(row => rowToRecord(row, hists||[]));
    assignees = (asgns||[]).map(a => a.name);
    users = (usrs||[]).map(u => u.name);
    if(!e3){
      if(dtypes && dtypes.length>0){
        docTypes = dtypes.map(d => d.name);
      }else{
        // doc_typesテーブルは存在するがまだ空 → 初期値を一度だけ投入
        docTypes = [...DEFAULT_DOC_TYPES];
        for(const name of DEFAULT_DOC_TYPES){ await dbSaveDocType(name); }
      }
    }else{
      // doc_typesテーブルが未作成 → クライアント側の初期値のみで動作（DBには保存されません）
      docTypes = [...DEFAULT_DOC_TYPES];
    }
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderDashboard();
    refreshAllAssigneeSelects();
    refreshAllUserSelects();
    refreshAllDocTypeSelects();
    refreshExportSelects();
    // 設定画面をすでに開いていた場合に備え、マスタ一覧の表示も再描画する
    renderAssigneeList();
    renderUserList();
    renderDocTypeList();
    await dbLoadSettings();
    renderSettingsForm();
    renderDriveScopeBanner();
    showToast(`✅ ${records.length}件の書類を読み込みました`);
  }

  /* ===== アプリ設定（会社情報・Google Driveフォルダ等）汎用key-valueストア ===== */
  let appSettings = {};

  async function dbLoadSettings(){
    try{
      const { data, error } = await db.from('app_settings').select('*');
      if(!error && data){
        appSettings = {};
        data.forEach(row => { appSettings[row.key] = row.value; });
      }
    }catch(e){ console.error('dbLoadSettings error:', e); }
  }

  async function dbSaveSetting(key, value){
    try{
      const { error } = await db.from('app_settings').upsert({key, value}, {onConflict:'key'});
      if(error) console.error(`dbSaveSetting（${key}）（app_settingsテーブルが未作成の可能性があります）:`, error);
    }catch(e){ console.error('dbSaveSetting error:', e); }
  }

  // Google DriveのフォルダURLからフォルダIDを抽出（IDを直接貼り付けた場合もそのまま使用）
  function parseDriveFolderId(input){
    if(!input) return '';
    const s = input.trim();
    const m = s.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if(m) return m[1];
    const m2 = s.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if(m2) return m2[1];
    if(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}$/.test(s)) return s; // IDを直接貼り付けた場合
    return '';
  }

  function renderSettingsForm(){
    const setVal=(id,val)=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el && val!==undefined) el.value=val||''; };
    setVal('s-company', appSettings.companyName);
    setVal('s-invoice', appSettings.invoiceNumber);
    if(appSettings.taxRate) setVal('s-tax', appSettings.taxRate);
    if(appSettings.fiscalYearStart) setVal('s-fy', appSettings.fiscalYearStart);
    const status=document.getElementById('s-drive-folder-status');
    if(status){
      status.textContent = appSettings.driveFolderId
        ? `✅ 連携中：${appSettings.driveFolderUrl||appSettings.driveFolderId}`
        : '連携フォルダ・取り込み条件・書類区切りなどを設定します';
    }
  }

  function renderDriveScopeBanner(){
    const banner=document.getElementById('drive-scope-banner');
    if(!banner) return;
    if(appSettings.driveFolderId){
      banner.style.display='flex';
      const subMsg = appSettings.driveIncludeSubfolders ? 'その配下のサブフォルダ（階層を問わずすべて）も含めて' : '';
      banner.innerHTML=`<i class="ti ti-folder-check" style="flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px"></i><span>検索範囲は設定画面で指定したフォルダ${subMsg?'と'+subMsg:''}に限定されています。<a href="#" onclick="openDriveSettings();return false;" style="color:#065f46;text-decoration:underline">設定を変更</a></span>`;
    }else{
      banner.style.display='none';
    }
  }

  /* ===== Googleドライブ取込設定モーダル ===== */
  function openDriveSettings(){
    const setVal=(id,val)=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el && val!==undefined) el.value=val||''; };
    setVal('ds-url', appSettings.driveFolderUrl);
    document.getElementById('ds-subfolders').checked = !!appSettings.driveIncludeSubfolders;
    setVal('ds-date-field', appSettings.driveDateField || 'createdTime');
    setVal('ds-date-value', appSettings.driveDateValue);
    setVal('ds-date-op', appSettings.driveDateOp || 'after');
    const dtSel = document.getElementById('ds-doctype');
    if(dtSel) dtSel.innerHTML = buildDocTypeOptions(appSettings.driveDefaultDocType || docTypes[0]);
    const splitMode = appSettings.driveSplitMode || 'file';
    document.querySelectorAll('input[name="ds-split"]').forEach(r=>{ r.checked = (r.value===splitMode); });
    document.getElementById('ds-move-enable').checked = !!appSettings.driveMoveEnable;
    document.getElementById('ds-move-folder-wrap').style.display = appSettings.driveMoveEnable ? 'block' : 'none';
    setVal('ds-move-folder-url', appSettings.driveMoveFolderUrl);
    document.getElementById('driveSettingsOverlay').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  }

  function closeDriveSettings(e){
    if(e && e.target !== document.getElementById('driveSettingsOverlay')) return;
    document.getElementById('driveSettingsOverlay').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='';
  }

  async function saveDriveSettingsModal(){
    const url = document.getElementById('ds-url').value.trim();
    const folderId = parseDriveFolderId(url);
    if(!url){ alert('URLを入力してください'); return; }
    if(!folderId){ alert('Google DriveのフォルダURLを正しく読み取れませんでした。\nURLの形式をご確認ください（例: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xxxxxxxxxxxxx）'); return; }
    const docType = document.getElementById('ds-doctype').value;
    if(!docType){ alert('書類（初期設定の書類種別）を選択してください'); return; }

    const includeSubfolders = document.getElementById('ds-subfolders').checked;
    const dateField = document.getElementById('ds-date-field').value;
    const dateValue = document.getElementById('ds-date-value').value;
    const dateOp = document.getElementById('ds-date-op').value;
    const splitMode = document.querySelector('input[name="ds-split"]:checked')?.value || 'file';
    const moveEnable = document.getElementById('ds-move-enable').checked;
    const moveFolderUrl = document.getElementById('ds-move-folder-url').value.trim();
    const moveFolderId = moveEnable ? parseDriveFolderId(moveFolderUrl) : '';
    if(moveEnable && moveFolderUrl && !moveFolderId){
      alert('移動先フォルダのURLを正しく読み取れませんでした。');
      return;
    }

    Object.assign(appSettings, {
      driveFolderUrl: url, driveFolderId: folderId,
      driveIncludeSubfolders: includeSubfolders,
      driveDateField: dateField, driveDateValue: dateValue, driveDateOp: dateOp,
      driveDefaultDocType: docType,
      driveSplitMode: splitMode,
      driveMoveEnable: moveEnable, driveMoveFolderUrl: moveFolderUrl, driveMoveFolderId: moveFolderId,
    });

    await Promise.all([
      dbSaveSetting('driveFolderUrl', url),
      dbSaveSetting('driveFolderId', folderId),
      dbSaveSetting('driveIncludeSubfolders', includeSubfolders ? '1' : ''),
      dbSaveSetting('driveDateField', dateField),
      dbSaveSetting('driveDateValue', dateValue),
      dbSaveSetting('driveDateOp', dateOp),
      dbSaveSetting('driveDefaultDocType', docType),
      dbSaveSetting('driveSplitMode', splitMode),
      dbSaveSetting('driveMoveEnable', moveEnable ? '1' : ''),
      dbSaveSetting('driveMoveFolderUrl', moveFolderUrl),
      dbSaveSetting('driveMoveFolderId', moveFolderId),
    ]);

    renderSettingsForm();
    renderDriveScopeBanner();
    closeDriveSettings();
    showToast('✅ Googleドライブ取込設定を保存しました');
  }

  /* ===== PDF実データの保存/取得（documents.pdf_data列）=====
     通常のdbSaveRecordはメタデータのみを更新し、PDF本体は含めない
     （毎回の項目編集で巨大なPDFを再送信しないため、また誤って空で
     上書きしないため）。PDF本体は登録時に一度だけ専用の関数で保存し、
     閲覧時に必要になったタイミングで一度だけ取得（遅延読込）する。 */
  function bytesToBase64(bytes){
    let binary='';
    const chunk=0x8000;
    for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=chunk){
      binary+=String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i+chunk));
    }
    return btoa(binary);
  }
  function base64ToBytes(b64){
    const binary=atob(b64);
    const bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++) bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }
  async function dbSavePdfData(id, bytes){
    if(!id || !bytes || !bytes.length) return;
    try{
      const b64 = bytesToBase64(bytes);
      const { error } = await db.from('documents').update({ pdf_data: b64 }).eq('id', id);
      if(error) console.error('dbSavePdfData（documentsテーブルにpdf_data列が無い可能性があります）:', error);
    }catch(e){ console.error('dbSavePdfData error:', e); }
  }
  async function loadPdfBytesForRecord(r){
    if(!r || r.pdfBytes || !r._id) return;
    try{
      const { data, error } = await db.from('documents').select('pdf_data').eq('id', r._id).single();
      if(!error && data && data.pdf_data){
        r.pdfBytes = base64ToBytes(data.pdf_data);
        return;
      }
    }catch(e){ console.error('loadPdfBytesForRecord error:', e); }
    // Supabase側に保存されていない場合、Google Drive連携の書類は元ファイルを再取得する
    if(!r.pdfBytes && r.driveId){
      try{
        const resp = await driveApiFetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${r.driveId}?alt=media&supportsAllDrives=true`);
        if(resp.ok){
          const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
          const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
          r.pdfBytes = bytes;
          if(r._id) await dbSavePdfData(r._id, bytes);
        }
      }catch(e){ console.error('loadPdfBytesForRecord drive fallback error:', e); }
    }
  }

  function recordToRow(rec) {
    return {
      id: rec._id,
      date: rec.date||null,
      amount: rec.amount||0,
      vendor: rec.vendor||'',
      type: rec.type||'請求書',
      note: rec.note||null,
      assignee: rec.assignee||null,
      user_name: rec.user||null,
      filename: rec.filename||'',
      original_name: rec.originalName||null,
      gmail_id: rec.gmailId||null,
      drive_id: rec.driveId||null,
      source: rec.source||'manual',
      status: rec.status||'pending',
      registered_at: rec.registeredAt||rec.savedAt||new Date().toISOString(),
      confirmed_at: rec.confirmedAt||null,
      sha256: rec.sha256||null,
      is_deleted: rec.deleted||false,
      deleted_at: rec.deletedAt||null,
      memo: rec.memo||null,
    };
  }

  function rowToRecord(row, allHists) {
    const history = (allHists||[])
      .filter(h=>h.document_id===row.id)
      .map(h=>({type:h.history_type, detail:h.detail, at:h.occurred_at}));
    return {
      _id: row.id,
      date: row.date||'',
      amount: row.amount||0,
      vendor: row.vendor||'',
      type: row.type||'請求書',
      note: row.note||'',
      assignee: row.assignee||'',
      user: row.user_name||'',
      filename: row.filename||'',
      originalName: row.original_name||'',
      pdfBytes: null,
      gmailId: row.gmail_id||'',
      driveId: row.drive_id||'',
      source: row.source||'manual',
      status: row.status||'pending',
      savedAt: row.registered_at,
      registeredAt: row.registered_at,
      confirmedAt: row.confirmed_at||'',
      sha256: row.sha256||'',
      deleted: row.is_deleted||false,
      deletedAt: row.deleted_at||'',
      memo: row.memo||'',
      history: history,
    };
  }

  }

  /* ===== SHA-256ハッシュ生成 ===== */
  async function calcHash(pdfBytes, filename, date, amount, vendor){
    try{
      let data;
      if(pdfBytes && pdfBytes.length>0){
        data=pdfBytes;
      }else{
        const meta=`${filename}|${date}|${amount}|${vendor}|${new Date().toISOString()}`;
        data=new TextEncoder().encode(meta);
      }
      const hashBuffer=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    }catch(e){ return null; }
  }

  /* ===== ステータス管理 ===== */
  // すべての登録はこの関数経由で → 常にpendingで登録
  async function pushRecord(rec){
    rec.status='pending';
    rec.registeredAt=new Date().toISOString();
    rec.sha256=await calcHash(rec.pdfBytes,rec.filename,rec.date,rec.amount,rec.vendor);
    rec.history=[];
    // DB用のUUIDを付与
    rec._id = crypto.randomUUID();
    addHistory(rec,'create',`書類を登録（${rec.source==='gmail'?'Gmail連携':rec.source==='auto'?'自動取込':'手動取込'}）`);
    records.push(rec);
    updatePendingBadge();
    // Supabaseに保存（メタデータ）
    await dbSaveRecord(rec);
    if(rec.history.length>0) await dbSaveHistory(rec._id, rec.history[rec.history.length-1]);
    // PDF本体も保存（あれば）。再読み込み後もプレビューできるようにするため。
    if(rec.pdfBytes && rec.pdfBytes.length) await dbSavePdfData(rec._id, rec.pdfBytes);
  }

  async function confirmRecord(i){
    records[i].status='confirmed';
    records[i].confirmedAt=new Date().toISOString();
    addHistory(records[i],'status','確定待ち → 確定済み');
    if(!records[i].sha256){
      const r=records[i];
      records[i].sha256=await calcHash(r.pdfBytes,r.filename,r.date,r.amount,r.vendor);
    }
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
    renderDashboardIfVisible();
    if(vIdx===i) renderViewerDetail();
    // Supabaseに保存
    await dbSaveRecord(records[i]);
    const h=records[i].history;
    if(h.length>0) await dbSaveHistory(records[i]._id, h[h.length-1]);
  }

  function unconfirmRecord(i){
    records[i].status='pending';
    delete records[i].confirmedAt;
    addHistory(records[i],'status','確定済み → 確定待ち（確定解除）');
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
    renderDashboardIfVisible();
    if(vIdx===i) renderViewerDetail();
  }

  function confirmAll(){
    getFilteredRecords().filter(r=>r.status==='pending').forEach(r=>{
      r.status='confirmed';
      r.confirmedAt=new Date().toISOString();
    });
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
    renderDashboardIfVisible();
  }

  function updatePendingBadge(){
    const cnt=records.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
    const badge=document.getElementById('pending-badge');
    badge.style.display=cnt>0?'':'none';
    badge.textContent=cnt;
  }

  }

  window._pdf=null;window._pdfDoc=null;window._pageData=[];window._curPage=0;

  // 指定ページだけのPDFバイナリをpdf-libで生成して返す
  async function extractPageBytes(srcBytes, pageIndex){
    try{
      const PDFDocument = PDFLib.PDFDocument;
      const srcDoc = await PDFDocument.load(srcBytes);
      const newDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
      const [copiedPage] = await newDoc.copyPages(srcDoc, [pageIndex]);
      newDoc.addPage(copiedPage);
      return await newDoc.save();
    }catch(e){
      console.warn('extractPageBytes error:', e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function setP(pct,label){document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width=pct+'%';document.getElementById('progressLabel').textContent=label;}

  function hasEnoughText(txt){
    return txt && txt.replace(/\s/g,'').length > 30;
  }

  function isImageFile(file){
    if(file.type==='image/jpeg' || file.type==='image/png') return true;
    return /\.(jpe?g|png)$/i.test(file.name||'');
  }

  // ファイル名から画像の拡張子・MIMEタイプを判定（PDFの場合はnull）
  function imageInfoFromName(name){
    if(/\.png$/i.test(name||'')) return {ext:'png', mime:'image/png'};
    if(/\.jpe?g$/i.test(name||'')) return {ext:'jpg', mime:'image/jpeg'};
    return null;
  }

  // 保存ファイル名の拡張子から、ダウンロード/表示に使うMIMEタイプを判定
  function mimeTypeForFilename(name){
    const info = imageInfoFromName(name);
    return info ? info.mime : 'application/pdf';
  }

  async function handleFile(file){
    resetImport();
    let buf=await file.arrayBuffer();
    window._origImageBytes=null;
    window._origImageMime=null;
    window._pendingIsImage=false;
    if(isImageFile(file)){
      const mimeType = file.type==='image/png' ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg';
      window._origImageBytes=new Uint8Array(buf.slice(0));
      window._origImageMime=mimeType;
      window._pendingIsImage=true;
      window._pdf=new Uint8Array(buf.slice(0));
      window._pdfDoc=null;
      window._pendingFileName=file.name;
      window._pendingNumPages=1;
      await startImport('single');
      return;
    }
    window._pdf=new Uint8Array(buf.slice(0));
    const pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:buf, ...PDFJS_DOC_OPTS}).promise;
    window._pdfDoc=pdf;
    window._pendingFileName=file.name;
    window._pendingNumPages=pdf.numPages;
    if(pdf.numPages===1){await startImport('single');}
    else{
      document.getElementById('splitModal').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('splitModalTitle').textContent=`${file.name}（${pdf.numPages}ページ）`;
      document.getElementById('splitModalSub').textContent=`このPDFは ${pdf.numPages} ページあります。登録方法を選択してください。`;
    }
  }

  async function startImport(mode){
    const fname=window._pendingFileName||'',numPages=window._pendingNumPages||1;
    document.getElementById('splitModal').style.display='none';
    if(mode==='single'){
      document.getElementById('fileName').textContent=fname;
    const spn=document.getElementById('single-preview-name');
    if(spn) spn.textContent=fname;
    const spw=document.getElementById('single-preview-link');
    if(spw) spw.style.display='none';
      document.getElementById('importCard').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('resultArea').style.display='none';
      document.getElementById('progressArea').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('statusBadge').textContent='解析中';
      document.getElementById('statusBadge').className='badge badge-new';
      setP(10,'テキストを抽出中...');
      try{
        let fullText='';
        if(!window._pendingIsImage){
          for(let i=1;i<=numPages;i++){
            setP(10+(i/numPages)*40,`テキスト抽出中 (${i}/${numPages}ページ)...`);
            const page=await window._pdfDoc.getPage(i);
            const pageText=(await page.getTextContent()).items.map(it=>it.str).join(' ');
            fullText+=pageText+'\n';
          }
        }else{
          setP(50,'画像を確認中...');
        }
        setP(80,'解析中...');
        const parsed=analyze(fullText);
        setP(100,'完了');
        // 表示用テキストも丸数字変換して見やすく
        const displayText=(t=>{
          const cn={'①':'1','②':'2','③':'3','④':'4','⑤':'5','⑥':'6','⑦':'7','⑧':'8','⑨':'9','⑩':'10',
                    '⑪':'11','⑫':'12','⑬':'13','⑭':'14','⑮':'15','⑯':'16','⑰':'17','⑱':'18','⑲':'19','⑳':'20'};
          for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cn)) t=t.replaceAll(k,v);
          return t.replace(/[①-⑳]/g,m=>String(m.codePointAt(0)-0x245F));
        })(fullText);
        document.getElementById('ocrText').textContent=displayText.trim();
        applyField('fieldDate','confDate','candDate',parsed.date,parsed.dateCands,'date');
        applyField('fieldAmount','confAmount','candAmount',parsed.amount,parsed.amountCands,'amount');
        applyField('fieldVendor','confVendor','candVendor',parsed.vendor,parsed.vendorCands,'vendor');
        document.getElementById('fieldNote').value='';
        if(parsed.type) document.getElementById('fieldType').value=parsed.type;
        document.getElementById('progressArea').style.display='none';
        document.getElementById('resultArea').style.display='block';
        document.getElementById('statusBadge').textContent='抽出完了';
        document.getElementById('statusBadge').className='badge badge-done';
        // 単一ページモードでも別タブで開くリンクを表示
        const previewLinkWrap=document.getElementById('single-preview-link');
        if(previewLinkWrap&&window._pdf){
          previewLinkWrap.style.display='flex';
          document.getElementById('single-preview-btn').onclick=()=>{
            const blob = window._origImageBytes
              ? new Blob([window._origImageBytes], {type: window._origImageMime})
              : new Blob([window._pdf],{type:'application/pdf'});
            const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            window.open(url,'_blank');
            setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000);
          };
        }
        updateFN('fieldDate','fieldAmount','fieldVendor','filenamePreview','fieldType', window._pendingIsImage ? (window._origImageMime==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf');
        ['fieldDate','fieldAmount','fieldVendor'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input',()=>updateFN('fieldDate','fieldAmount','fieldVendor','filenamePreview','fieldType', window._pendingIsImage ? (window._origImageMime==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf')));
        document.getElementById('fieldType').addEventListener('change',()=>updateFN('fieldDate','fieldAmount','fieldVendor','filenamePreview','fieldType', window._pendingIsImage ? (window._origImageMime==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf'));
      }catch(err){
        setP(100,'エラー: '+err.message);
        document.getElementById('statusBadge').textContent='エラー';
        document.getElementById('statusBadge').className='badge badge-skip';
        document.getElementById('progressArea').style.display='none';
        document.getElementById('resultArea').style.display='block';
        document.getElementById('ocrText').textContent=err.message+'\n\n手動で入力してください。';
      }
    }else{
      document.getElementById('splitCard').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('splitFileName').textContent=fname;
      document.getElementById('splitPageInfo').textContent=`全${numPages}ページ`;
      document.getElementById('splitProgressArea').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('splitForms').style.display='none';
      window._pageData=[];
      const thumbRow=document.getElementById('pageThumbRow'),tabsEl=document.getElementById('pageTabs');
      thumbRow.innerHTML='';tabsEl.innerHTML='';
      for(let i=1;i<=numPages;i++){
        document.getElementById('splitProgressBar').style.width=Math.round((i/numPages)*90)+'%';
        document.getElementById('splitProgressLabel').textContent=`ページ ${i}/${numPages} を解析中...`;
        const page=await window._pdfDoc.getPage(i);
        let pageText=(await page.getTextContent()).items.map(it=>it.str).join(' ');
      
        const vp=page.getViewport({scale:0.15}),canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width=vp.width;canvas.height=vp.height;
        await page.render({canvasContext:canvas.getContext('2d'),viewport:vp}).promise;
        // 高解像度プレビュー用canvasも生成して保持
        const vpHi=page.getViewport({scale:1.5}),canvasHi=document.createElement('canvas');
        canvasHi.width=vpHi.width;canvasHi.height=vpHi.height;
        await page.render({canvasContext:canvasHi.getContext('2d'),viewport:vpHi}).promise;
        window._pageData.push({pageNum:i,text:pageText,parsed:analyze(pageText),thumbCanvas:canvas,hiCanvas:canvasHi,saved:false});
        const thumbDiv=document.createElement('div');
        thumbDiv.className='page-thumb'+(i===1?' active':'');
        // ページ番号ラベル
        const numLabel=document.createElement('span');
        numLabel.className='page-thumb-num';
        numLabel.textContent=i+'P';
        // ホバーオーバーレイ
        const overlay=document.createElement('div');
        overlay.className='page-thumb-overlay';
        const openBtn=document.createElement('button');
        openBtn.className='page-thumb-open';
        openBtn.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-external-link" style="font-size:11px"></i>別タブで開く';
        openBtn.onclick=(e)=>{e.stopPropagation();openPageInTab(i-1);};
        overlay.appendChild(openBtn);
        thumbDiv.onclick=()=>selectPage(i-1);
        thumbDiv.appendChild(canvas);
        thumbDiv.appendChild(numLabel);
        thumbDiv.appendChild(overlay);
        thumbRow.appendChild(thumbDiv);
        const tab=document.createElement('button');
        tab.className='page-tab'+(i===1?' active':'');
        tab.id=`ptab-${i-1}`;tab.textContent=`${i}ページ`;
        tab.onclick=()=>selectPage(i-1);
        tabsEl.appendChild(tab);
      }
      document.getElementById('splitProgressBar').style.width='100%';
      document.getElementById('splitProgressLabel').textContent='解析完了';
      setTimeout(()=>{
        document.getElementById('splitProgressArea').style.display='none';
        renderSplitForms();
        document.getElementById('splitForms').style.display='block';
        selectPage(0);
      },300);
    }
  }

  function renderSplitForms(){

          <div class="field"><label>書類種別</label><select id="sp-type-${idx}">${buildDocTypeOptions(pd.parsed.type||docTypes[0])}</select></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field"><label>摘要・備考</label><input type="text" id="sp-note-${idx}" value="" placeholder="例: 2024年11月分"/></div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field"><label>担当者</label><select id="sp-assignee-${idx}" class="assignee-select"></select></div>
          <div class="field"><label>利用者</label><select id="sp-user-${idx}" class="assignee-select"></select></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fn-preview"><div class="fn-label">保存ファイル名プレビュー</div><div class="fn-name" id="sp-fn-${idx}">—</div></div>
      </div>`).join('');
    // 分割フォームの担当者・利用者プルダウンを初期化
    window._pageData.forEach((_,idx)=>{
      const sel=document.getElementById(`sp-assignee-${idx}`);
      if(sel) sel.innerHTML=buildAssigneeOptions('');
      const usel=document.getElementById(`sp-user-${idx}`);
      if(usel) usel.innerHTML=buildUserOptions('');
    });
    window._pageData.forEach((pd,idx)=>{
      showConf(`sp-conf-date-${idx}`,pd.parsed.date?.conf||0);
      showConf(`sp-conf-amount-${idx}`,pd.parsed.amount?.conf||0);
      showConf(`sp-conf-vendor-${idx}`,pd.parsed.vendor?.conf||0);
      ['sp-date-','sp-amount-','sp-vendor-'].forEach(pre=>document.getElementById(pre+idx).addEventListener('input',()=>updateSplitFN(idx)));
      document.getElementById(`sp-type-${idx}`).addEventListener('change',()=>updateSplitFN(idx));
      updateSplitFN(idx);
    });
  }

  function showConf(id,conf){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;const cls=conf>=3?'conf-h':conf>=2?'conf-m':'conf-l';const lbl=conf>=3?'高信頼度':conf>=2?'中信頼度':'低信頼度 — 確認推奨';el.innerHTML=`<span class="conf-dot ${cls}"></span><span>${lbl}</span>`;}
  function updateSplitFN(idx){const d=document.getElementById(`sp-date-${idx}`).value,a=document.getElementById(`sp-amount-${idx}`).value,v=document.getElementById(`sp-vendor-${idx}`).value,t=document.getElementById(`sp-type-${idx}`).value;document.getElementById(`sp-fn-${idx}`).textContent=(d&&a&&v)?buildFN(d,a,v,t):'（日付・金額・取引先を入力してください）';}

  function selectPage(idx){
    window._curPage=idx;
    document.querySelectorAll('.split-page-form').forEach((el,i)=>el.style.display=i===idx?'block':'none');
    document.querySelectorAll('.page-tab').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('active',i===idx));
    document.querySelectorAll('.page-thumb').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('active',i===idx));
  }

  // サムネイルの「別タブで開く」— 高解像度canvasをそのまま新タブで表示
  function openPageInTab(idx){
    const pd=window._pageData[idx];
    if(!pd){return;}
    // 高解像度canvasがあればそれを使用、なければthumbCanvasを使用
    const srcCanvas=pd.hiCanvas||pd.thumbCanvas;
    // PDFバイナリがある場合は全ページPDFをBlobで開く（そのページへスクロールはブラウザ依存）
    if(window._pdf){
      const blob=new Blob([window._pdf],{type:'application/pdf'});
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      // PDFを新タブで開き、ページ番号をハッシュで指定
      const win=window.open(url+'#page='+pd.pageNum,'_blank');
      // タブが閉じられたらURLを解放（タイマーで遅延解放）
      setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000);
      return;
    }
    // PDFバイナリがない場合はcanvasを画像として新タブで開く
    const dataUrl=srcCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    const html=`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>${pd.pageNum}ページ目</title><style>body{margin:0;background:#525659;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:20px}img{max-width:100%;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}</style></head><body><img src="${dataUrl}"/></body></html>`;
    const blob=new Blob([html],{type:'text/html'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    window.open(url,'_blank');
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);
  }

  async function saveAllPages(){
    let saved=0,errors=[];
    for(let idx=0;idx<window._pageData.length;idx++){
      const date=document.getElementById(`sp-date-${idx}`).value;
      const amount=document.getElementById(`sp-amount-${idx}`).value.replace(/[^\d]/g,'');
      const vendor=document.getElementById(`sp-vendor-${idx}`).value.trim();
      if(!date||!amount||!vendor){errors.push(`${idx+1}ページ目: 日付・金額・取引先が未入力`);continue;}
      const pageBytes=window._pdf?await extractPageBytes(window._pdf,idx):null;
      pushRecord({date,amount:parseInt(amount),vendor,type:document.getElementById(`sp-type-${idx}`).value,note:document.getElementById(`sp-note-${idx}`).value,
        assignee:(document.getElementById(`sp-assignee-${idx}`)?.value||''),
        user:(document.getElementById(`sp-user-${idx}`)?.value||''),
        filename:buildFN(date,amount,vendor,document.getElementById(`sp-type-${idx}`).value),originalName:`${window._pendingFileName}_p${idx+1}.pdf`,
        pdfBytes:pageBytes||window._pdf,source:'manual',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
      const tab=document.getElementById(`ptab-${idx}`);if(tab){tab.classList.add('saved');tab.textContent=`${idx+1}ページ ✓`;}
      saved++;
    }
    if(errors.length) alert(`${saved}件保存しました（確定待ち）。\n\n未入力ページ:\n${errors.join('\n')}`);
    else{alert(`全${saved}ページを保存しました（確定待ち）`);resetImport();nav('records');}
  }

  function saveRecord(){
    const date=document.getElementById('fieldDate').value;
    const amount=document.getElementById('fieldAmount').value.replace(/[^\d]/g,'');
    const vendor=document.getElementById('fieldVendor').value.trim();
    if(!date||!amount||!vendor){alert('日付・金額・取引先は必須です');return;}
    const ext = window._pendingIsImage ? (window._origImageMime==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf';
    const filename=buildFN(date,amount,vendor,document.getElementById('fieldType').value,ext);
    pushRecord({date,amount:parseInt(amount),vendor,type:document.getElementById('fieldType').value,note:document.getElementById('fieldNote').value,
      assignee:document.getElementById('fieldAssignee').value||'',
      user:document.getElementById('fieldUser').value||'',
      filename,originalName:window._pendingFileName||'',pdfBytes:window._pdf||null,source:'manual',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    window._pdf=null;
    alert('保存しました（確定待ち）:\n'+filename);
    resetImport();nav('records');
  }
