  /* ===== Google Drive連携 ===== */
  async function searchDrive(latest=false){
    document.getElementById('drive-loading').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('drive-results').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('drive-import-panel').style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('d-loading-msg').textContent='Google Driveを検索中...';
    try{
      const keyword=document.getElementById('d-keyword').value.trim();
      const fromDate=document.getElementById('d-from-date').value,toDate=document.getElementById('d-to-date').value;
      const folderId=appSettings.driveFolderId||'';
      const includeSubfolders=!!appSettings.driveIncludeSubfolders;

      let q=`(mimeType='application/pdf' or mimeType='image/jpeg' or mimeType='image/png') and trashed=false`;
      if(!latest){
        if(keyword) q+=` and name contains '${keyword.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}'`;
        if(fromDate) q+=` and modifiedTime >= '${fromDate}T00:00:00'`;
        if(toDate) q+=` and modifiedTime <= '${toDate}T23:59:59'`;
      }
      if(appSettings.driveDateValue && appSettings.driveDateField){
        const cmp = appSettings.driveDateOp==='before' ? '<=' : '>=';
        const t = appSettings.driveDateOp==='before' ? 'T23:59:59' : 'T00:00:00';
        q+=` and ${appSettings.driveDateField} ${cmp} '${appSettings.driveDateValue}${t}'`;
      }

      if(folderId){
        let folderIds=[folderId];
        if(includeSubfolders){
          const subs = await listDriveSubfolders(folderId);
          folderIds = folderIds.concat(subs);
        }
        const parentClause = folderIds.map(id=>`'${id}' in parents`).join(' or ');
        q += ` and (${parentClause})`;
      }

      const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,createdTime,owners,webViewLink)&orderBy=modifiedTime desc&pageSize=20&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true&corpora=allDrives`;
      const resp = await driveApiFetch(url);
      if(!resp.ok){
        const errBody = await resp.text();
        throw new Error(`Drive APIエラー (${resp.status}): ${errBody.slice(0,200)}`);
      }
      const data = await resp.json();
      driveFiles = (data.files||[]).map(f=>({
        id: f.id, name: f.name,
        mimeType: f.mimeType||'',
        modifiedTime: (f.modifiedTime||'').slice(0,10),
        owner: (f.owners&&f.owners[0]&&f.owners[0].displayName)||'',
        webViewLink: f.webViewLink||'',
      }));
      renderDriveList(driveFiles);
    }catch(err){
      driveFiles=[];renderDriveList([],err.message);
    }
    document.getElementById('drive-loading').style.display='none';
  }

  function renderDriveList(files,errMsg){
    document.getElementById('drive-results').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('d-count').textContent=errMsg?'':`（${files.length}件）`;
    const list=document.getElementById('drive-list');
    if(errMsg){list.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-wifi-off"></i><p>Google Drive接続エラー<br><small>${escHtml(errMsg)}</small></p></div>`;return;}
    if(!files.length){list.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-file-off"></i><p>PDFファイルが見つかりませんでした</p></div>';return;}
    list.innerHTML=files.map((f,i)=>{
      const already=records.some(r=>r.driveId===f.id);
      return `<div class="mail-row"><input type="checkbox" id="dchk-${i}" ${already?'disabled checked':''} style="margin-top:3px;flex-shrink:0"/><div class="mail-body"><div class="mail-from"><i class="ti ti-file-type-pdf" style="color:#ef4444;margin-right:4px"></i>${escHtml(f.name||'')}</div><div class="mail-subject">${escHtml(f.owner||'')}</div><div class="mail-date">更新日: ${f.modifiedTime||''}</div>${already?'<span class="badge badge-done" style="margin-top:4px;display:inline-flex">取込済み</span>':''}</div><div style="flex-shrink:0">${!already?`<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="openDriveImport(${i})"><i class="ti ti-download"></i>取り込む</button>`:''}</div></div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  let pendingDriveExtra=[];

  function applyDriveImportFields(parsed, text, pdfBytes, multiCount){
    pendingDrive.pdfBytes = pdfBytes;
    document.getElementById('dimp-ocr').textContent = (text||'').slice(0,500) || '（抽出できませんでした）';
    document.getElementById('dimp-date').value = (parsed.date&&parsed.date.val)||'';
    document.getElementById('dimp-amount').value = (parsed.amount&&parsed.amount.val)||'';
    document.getElementById('dimp-vendor').value = (parsed.vendor&&parsed.vendor.val)||'';
    document.getElementById('dimp-note').value = '';
    document.getElementById('dimp-type').value = parsed.type || appSettings.driveDefaultDocType || docTypes[0];
    document.getElementById('dimp-progress').style.display='none';document.getElementById('dimp-fields').style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('dimp-status').textContent = (multiCount>1) ? `${multiCount}件検出` : '抽出完了';
    document.getElementById('dimp-status').className='badge badge-done';
    updateFN('dimp-date','dimp-amount','dimp-vendor','dimp-fn','dimp-type', pendingDrive?.isImage ? (pendingDrive.mimeType==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf');
    ['dimp-date','dimp-amount','dimp-vendor'].forEach(id=>{
      document.getElementById(id).oninput=()=>updateFN('dimp-date','dimp-amount','dimp-vendor','dimp-fn','dimp-type', pendingDrive?.isImage ? (pendingDrive.mimeType==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf');
    });
    document.getElementById('dimp-type').onchange=()=>updateFN('dimp-date','dimp-amount','dimp-vendor','dimp-fn','dimp-type', pendingDrive?.isImage ? (pendingDrive.mimeType==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf');
  }

  function openDriveImportPreview(){
    if(!window._driveOrigBytes) return;
    const blob=new Blob([window._driveOrigBytes], {type: window._driveOrigMime||'application/pdf'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    window.open(url,'_blank');
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000);
  }

  async function openDriveImport(i){
    const file=driveFiles[i];if(!file)return;
    const panel=document.getElementById('drive-import-panel');
    panel.style.display='block';panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
    document.getElementById('dimp-filename').textContent=file.name||'file.pdf';
    document.getElementById('dimp-status').textContent='取得中';document.getElementById('dimp-status').className='badge badge-new';
    document.getElementById('dimp-fields').style.display='none';document.getElementById('dimp-progress').style.display='block';
    const dpb=document.getElementById('dimp-preview-btn');if(dpb) dpb.style.display='none';
    window._driveOrigBytes=null;window._driveOrigMime=null;
    setDP(10,'ファイルを取得中...');
    const splitMode = appSettings.driveSplitMode || 'file';
    try{
      const resp = await driveApiFetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${file.id}?alt=media&supportsAllDrives=true`);
      if(!resp.ok) throw new Error(`ファイル取得エラー (${resp.status})`);
      const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
      window._driveOrigBytes=new Uint8Array(buf.slice(0));
      window._driveOrigMime=file.mimeType||'application/pdf';
      const fileBytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
      const isImage = file.mimeType==='image/jpeg' || file.mimeType==='image/png';
      if(dpb){
        dpb.style.display='inline-flex';
      }

      if(isImage){
        // 画像ファイルはPDF変換せず、そのままのバイト列を保持する（ダウンロード時に拡張子を保つため）
        setDP(50,'画像を確認中...');
        const parsed = analyze('');
        setDP(95,'解析完了');
        pendingDrive = {fileId:file.id, filename:file.name||'file', pdfBytes: fileBytes, isImage:true, mimeType:file.mimeType};
        pendingDriveExtra = [];
        applyDriveImportFields(parsed, '', fileBytes, 1);
        return;
      }

      setDP(30,'PDFを解析中...');
      const pdfDoc = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:fileBytes.slice(0), ...PDFJS_DOC_OPTS}).promise;
      const numPages = pdfDoc.numPages;

      pendingDrive = {fileId:file.id, filename:file.name||'file.pdf', pdfBytes: fileBytes};
      pendingDriveExtra = [];

      if(splitMode==='file' || numPages===1){
        let fullText='';
        for(let p=1;p<=numPages;p++){
          setDP(30+Math.round((p/numPages)*50), `テキスト抽出中 (${p}/${numPages}ページ)...`);
          const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(p);
          const pageText = (await page.getTextContent()).items.map(it=>it.str).join(' ');
          fullText += pageText+'\n';
}
        const parsed = analyze(fullText);
        setDP(95,'解析完了');
        applyDriveImportFields(parsed, fullText, fileBytes, 1);
      } else {
        setDP(35,`${numPages}ページを解析中...`);
        const pageInfos=[];
        for(let p=1;p<=numPages;p++){
          setDP(35+Math.round((p/numPages)*35), `ページ ${p}/${numPages} を解析中...`);
          const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(p);
          let pageText=(await page.getTextContent()).items.map(it=>it.str).join(' ');
          pageInfos.push({idx:p-1, text:pageText});
        }
        let groups=[];
        if(splitMode==='page'){
          groups = pageInfos.map(pi=>[pi.idx]);
        }else{ // blank：テキストがほぼ無いページを区切りとみなす
          let cur=[];
          for(const pi of pageInfos){
            const isBlank = !hasEnoughText(pi.text);
            if(isBlank){
              if(cur.length){ groups.push(cur); cur=[]; }
            }else{
              cur.push(pi.idx);
            }
          }
          if(cur.length) groups.push(cur);
          if(!groups.length) groups=[pageInfos.map(pi=>pi.idx)];
        }
        setDP(75,'書類を分割中...');
        const docs=[];
        for(const idxs of groups){
          const text = idxs.map(idx=>pageInfos.find(p=>p.idx===idx).text).join('\n');
          const parsed = analyze(text);
          const pageBytes = await extractPagesBytes(fileBytes, idxs);
          docs.push(Object.assign({}, parsed, {text, pdfBytes: pageBytes || fileBytes}));
        }
        setDP(100,`${docs.length}件検出`);
        const first = docs[0];
        pendingDriveExtra = docs.slice(1);
        applyDriveImportFields(first, first.text, first.pdfBytes, docs.length);
      }
    }catch(err){
      setDP(100,'エラー: '+err.message);
      document.getElementById('dimp-ocr').textContent=err.message+'\n\n手動で入力してください。';
      document.getElementById('dimp-progress').style.display='none';document.getElementById('dimp-fields').style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('dimp-status').textContent='エラー';document.getElementById('dimp-status').className='badge badge-skip';
    }
  }

  function setDP(pct,label){document.getElementById('dimp-bar').style.width=pct+'%';document.getElementById('dimp-label').textContent=label;}

  async function importCheckedDrive(){
    const targets=driveFiles.map((f,i)=>({f,i,chk:document.getElementById('dchk-'+i)})).filter(({chk})=>chk&&chk.checked&&!chk.disabled);
    if(!targets.length){alert('取り込むファイルにチェックを入れてください');return;}
    for(const{i}of targets) await openDriveImport(i);
  }

  async function moveDriveFileAfterImport(fileId, fileName){
    if(!appSettings.driveMoveEnable || !appSettings.driveMoveFolderId || !fileId) return;
    try{
      const infoResp = await driveApiFetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?fields=parents&supportsAllDrives=true`);
      let removeParents = '';
      if(infoResp.ok){
        const info = await infoResp.json();
        removeParents = (info.parents||[]).join(',');
      }
      const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?addParents=${appSettings.driveMoveFolderId}${removeParents?'&removeParents='+removeParents:''}&supportsAllDrives=true`;
      await driveApiFetch(url, {method:'PATCH'});
    }catch(e){ console.error('moveDriveFileAfterImport error:', e); }
  }

  function saveDriveImport(){
    const date=document.getElementById('dimp-date').value;
    const amount=document.getElementById('dimp-amount').value.replace(/[^\d]/g,'');
    const vendor=document.getElementById('dimp-vendor').value.trim();
    if(!date||!amount||!vendor){alert('日付・金額・取引先は必須です');return;}
    const ext = pendingDrive?.isImage ? (pendingDrive.mimeType==='image/png'?'png':'jpg') : 'pdf';
    const filename=buildFN(date,amount,vendor,document.getElementById('dimp-type').value,ext);
    const assignee=document.getElementById('dimp-assignee').value||'';
    const user=document.getElementById('dimp-user').value||'';
    pushRecord({date,amount:parseInt(amount),vendor,type:document.getElementById('dimp-type').value,note:document.getElementById('dimp-note').value,
      assignee, user,
      filename,originalName:pendingDrive?.filename||'',driveId:pendingDrive?.fileId||'',
      pdfBytes: pendingDrive?.pdfBytes||null,
      source:'drive',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    // 「1ページ/空白ページ区切り」で複数書類が検出された場合、残りも確定待ちとして登録
    let extraCount=0;
    for(const doc of pendingDriveExtra){
      const d=(doc.date&&doc.date.val)||'', a=((doc.amount&&doc.amount.val)||'').toString().replace(/[^\d]/g,''), v=((doc.vendor&&doc.vendor.val)||'').trim(), t=doc.type||appSettings.driveDefaultDocType||docTypes[0];
      if(!d||!a||!v) continue; // 必須項目が読み取れなかった分はスキップ（後で手動登録）
      pushRecord({date:d,amount:parseInt(a),vendor:v,type:t,note:'',
        assignee, user,
        filename:buildFN(d,a,v,t),originalName:pendingDrive?.filename||'',driveId:pendingDrive?.fileId||'',
        pdfBytes: doc.pdfBytes||null,
        source:'drive',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
      extraCount++;
    }
    const skipped = pendingDriveExtra.length - extraCount;
    moveDriveFileAfterImport(pendingDrive?.fileId, pendingDrive?.filename);
    pendingDrive=null;pendingDriveExtra=[];
    document.getElementById('drive-import-panel').style.display='none';
    let msg='保存しました（確定待ち）:\n'+filename;
    if(extraCount>0) msg+=`\n他 ${extraCount} 件も同じファイルから検出し、確定待ちで登録しました。`;
    if(skipped>0) msg+=`\n${skipped} 件は日付・金額・取引先が読み取れなかったため未登録です。手動でインポートしてください。`;
    alert(msg);
    nav('records');
  }

  /* ===== テキスト解析 ===== */
  function analyze(rawText){
    // ===== OCRテキスト正規化 =====
    let text = rawText;
    // 文字間スペース除去 — 複数回適用して確実に除去
    // 「エ ン ザ ン ト レ イ ズ 株 式 会 社」→「エンザントレイズ株式会社」
    const jpChar = /[　-鿿＀-￯一-龯぀-ゟ゠-ヿ0-9a-zA-ZａーＡ]/;
    // 「1文字 + スペース + 1文字」パターンを繰り返し除去（最大10回）
    for(let _i=0;_i<10;_i++){
      const prev=text;
      text=text.replace(/(?<=[　-鿿＀-￯一-龯぀-ゟ゠-ヿ0-9a-zA-Z]) (?=[　-鿿＀-￯一-龯぀-ゟ゠-ヿ0-9a-zA-Z])/g,'');
      if(text===prev) break;
    }
    // ¥の代わりに \ が来るケース
    text = text.replace(/[\\|](?=[0-9])/g, '¥');
    // 金額のカンマ代わりに . が来るケース（例: 418.000 → 418,000）
    // 数字3桁の前の . をカンマに変換（小数点ではなく桁区切りと判断）
    text = text.replace(/(\d)\.(\d{3})(?=\D|$)/g, '$1,$2');
    // = を 令和の誤認識として扱う（「請求 ＝ 令和」等）
    text = text.replace(/[=＝]\s*令/g, '令');
    // 丸数字・囲み数字を通常の数字に変換（Tesseract OCR誤認識対策）
    const cn={'①':'1','②':'2','③':'3','④':'4','⑤':'5','⑥':'6','⑦':'7','⑧':'8','⑨':'9','⑩':'10',
              '⑪':'11','⑫':'12','⑬':'13','⑭':'14','⑮':'15','⑯':'16','⑰':'17','⑱':'18','⑲':'19','⑳':'20'};
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cn)) text=text.replaceAll(k,v);
    text=text.replace(/[\u2460-\u2473]/g,m=>String(m.codePointAt(0)-0x245F));
    // 丸数字が混入した数値の修正（例: T⑧o③000 → T8030002110407 には対応できないが数字部分は修正）
    text=text.replace(/[國囲圍]/g,'');  // ノイズ漢字除去
    text=text.replace(/[Ⓐ-ⓩⒶ-Ⓩ]/g,'');  // 囲み英字除去

    const r={date:{val:'',conf:0},amount:{val:'',conf:0},vendor:{val:'',conf:0},note:'',type:'',dateCands:[],amountCands:[],vendorCands:[]};

    // ===== 書類種別 =====
    const typeMap=[
      ['請求書','請求書'],['領収書','領収書'],['納品書','納品書'],['見積書','見積書'],
      ['発注書','発注書（注文書）'],['注文書','発注書（注文書）'],
      ['発注請書','発注請書（注文請書）'],['注文請書','発注請書（注文請書）'],
      ['クラウドサイン','クラウドサイン'],['インボイス','請求書'],
    ];
    for(const[k,v]of typeMap) if(text.includes(k)){r.type=v;break;}

    // ===== 取引日付 =====
    // テキスト全体を行に分割して位置情報も活用
    const lines=text.split(/\n/);
    const ds=new Set();

    const addDate=(y,mo,d,conf)=>{
      if(y<2000||y>2099||mo<1||mo>12||d<1||d>31) return;
      const key=`${y}-${String(mo).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
      if(!ds.has(key)){ds.add(key);r.dateCands.push({val:key,conf});}
    };

    // 優先度4: ラベル付き（発行日・請求日など）+ 年号表記
    const dLabel=/(?:発行日|請求日|作成日|発行年月日|請求年月日|取引日|納品日|日付|DATE)[^\d]*?(\d{4})[年\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[月\/\-\.](\d{1,2})日?/g;
    let m;
    while((m=dLabel.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1]),parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),4);

    // 優先度3: 令和・平成など元号（正確）
    const dReiwa=/令和\s*(\d{1,2})年\s*(\d{1,2})月\s*(\d{1,2})日/g;
    while((m=dReiwa.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1])+2018,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),3);
    const dHeisei=/平成\s*(\d{1,2})年\s*(\d{1,2})月\s*(\d{1,2})日/g;
    while((m=dHeisei.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1])+1988,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),3);

    // 優先度3: OCR誤認識対応 — 令和が1〜2文字の記号/ひらがなに化ける
    // 例: "i 8年 6月8日" "令 8年" "令8年" "R8年"
    const dReiwaOcr=/(?:令和?|[Rrilｉ令霊]\s*)(\d{1,2})\s*年\s*(\d{1,2})\s*月\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日/g;
    while((m=dReiwaOcr.exec(text))!==null){
      const y=parseInt(m[1]); if(y>=1&&y<=20) addDate(y+2018,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),3);
    }

    // 優先度2: 年月日漢字（4桁年）
    const dKanji=/(\d{4})[年](\d{1,2})[月](\d{1,2})[日]/g;
    while((m=dKanji.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1]),parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),2);

    // 優先度1: スラッシュ・ハイフン区切り（年4桁）
    const dSlash=/(\d{4})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})(?!\d)/g;
    while((m=dSlash.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1]),parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),1);

    // 優先度1: 短縮年号 R6.1.1 形式
    const dShort=/R(\d{1,2})[.\-\/](\d{1,2})[.\-\/](\d{1,2})/g;
    while((m=dShort.exec(text))!==null) addDate(parseInt(m[1])+2018,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),1);

    // 優先度3: 令和の後に記号・空白が入るOCR誤認識パターン
    // 例: "令和 _8 年 6 月8日" "令和_8年6月8日"
    const dReiwaLoose=/令和\s*[_\-\s]*(\d{1,2})\s*年\s*(\d{1,2})\s*月\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日/g;
    while((m=dReiwaLoose.exec(text))!==null){
      const y=parseInt(m[1]); if(y>=1&&y<=20) addDate(y+2018,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),3);
    }
    // 年月だけ取れる場合（日が別行に分かれたケース）
    const dReiwaYM=/令和\s*[_\-\s]*(\d{1,2})\s*年\s*(\d{1,2})\s*月/g;
    while((m=dReiwaYM.exec(text))!==null){
      const y=parseInt(m[1]); if(y>=1&&y<=20) addDate(y+2018,parseInt(m[2]),1,1);
    }

    // 優先度1: OCR誤認識 "XX年YY月ZZ日" — 年が2桁で令和相当のもの（1〜20年）
    const dReiwa2=/(?<![0-9])(\d{1,2})\s*年\s*(\d{1,2})\s*月\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日/g;
    while((m=dReiwa2.exec(text))!==null){
      const y=parseInt(m[1]); if(y>=1&&y<=20) addDate(y+2018,parseInt(m[2]),parseInt(m[3]),2);
    }

    r.dateCands.sort((a,b)=>b.conf-a.conf||b.val.localeCompare(a.val));
    if(r.dateCands.length) r.date=r.dateCands[0];

    // ===== 金額 =====
    const as=new Set();
    const addAmt=(raw,conf)=>{
      const n=parseInt(raw.replace(/,/g,''));
      if(isNaN(n)||n<100||n>999999999) return;
      const key=String(n);
      if(!as.has(key)){as.add(key);r.amountCands.push({val:key,conf,disp:'¥'+n.toLocaleString()});}
    };

    // 優先度4: 最終合計・ご請求金額など（最高優先）
    const aTop=/(?:ご請求金額|請求金額|合計金額|税込合計|お支払(?:い)?金額|総額|差引合計|最終合計|請求合計)[^\d]*?[¥￥]?\s*([\d,]+)/g;
    while((m=aTop.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],4);

    // 優先度3: 税込金額
    const aTax=/(?:税込(?:金額)?|消費税込)[^\d]*?[¥￥]?\s*([\d,]+)/g;
    while((m=aTax.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],3);

    // 優先度2: 合計・TOTAL
    const aTotal=/(?:^|[ 　])(?:合\s*計|小\s*計|TOTAL|Total|total)[^\d]*?[¥￥]?\s*([\d,]+)/gm;
    while((m=aTotal.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],2);

    // 優先度2: 金額ラベル付き
    const aLabel=/(?:金額|Amount)[^\d]*?[¥￥]?\s*([\d,]{4,})/g;
    while((m=aLabel.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],2);

    // 優先度1: ¥・￥記号付き（4桁以上）
    const aYen=/[¥￥]([\d,]{4,})/g;
    while((m=aYen.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],1);

    // 優先度1: N円（5桁以上）
    const aEn=/([\d,]{5,})\s*円/g;
    while((m=aEn.exec(text))!==null) addAmt(m[1],1);

    // 同conf内では金額が大きいものを優先（合計は明細より大きいことが多い）
    r.amountCands.sort((a,b)=>b.conf-a.conf||parseInt(b.val)-parseInt(a.val));
    if(r.amountCands.length) r.amount=r.amountCands[0];

    // ===== 取引先 =====
    const vs=new Set();
    const addVendor=(v,conf)=>{
      v=v.trim().replace(/^[_\-\s　。、[\]|>@#※ーｰ～〜]+/,'').replace(/[_\-\s　。、[\]|>@#※]+$/,'').replace(/[（(].*?[)）]/g,'').replace(/\s/g,'').trim();
      if(v.length<2||v.length>40||vs.has(v)) return;
      vs.add(v); r.vendorCands.push({val:v,conf});
    };

    // 法人格リスト（前後どちらでも対応）
    const corpTypes='株式会社|有限会社|合同会社|一般社団法人|公益社団法人|一般財団法人|公益財団法人|医療法人|学校法人|社会福祉法人|協同組合|事業協同組合|NPO法人|特定非営利活動法人|弁護士法人|税理士法人|監査法人';

    // 行単位で法人格数を判定して取引先を抽出
    let vm;
    text.split('\n').forEach(line=>{
      const t=line.trim().replace(/[>＞\[\]|｜@#]/g,'').trim();
      const corpMatches=[...(t.matchAll(new RegExp(corpTypes,'g')))];
      if(corpMatches.length===1){
        // 法人格の前後に合計で3文字以上の名称部分があること（「有限会社 ト」などを除外）
        const m=corpMatches[0];
        const before=t.slice(0,m.index).trim();
        const after=t.slice(m.index+m[0].length).trim();
        const nameLen=before.length+after.length;
        if(nameLen>=2 && t.length>=5 && t.length<=35){
          // 名称部分が十分ある → 信頼度5
          addVendor(t,5);
        }
      } else if(corpMatches.length>=2){
        // 法人格が2つ以上ある行 → 最初の法人格で打ち切る
        const firstEnd=corpMatches[0].index+corpMatches[0][0].length;
        const candidate=t.slice(0,firstEnd).trim();
        // 切り取った部分に名称がある場合のみ採用
        const before2=t.slice(0,corpMatches[0].index).trim();
        if(before2.length>=1) addVendor(candidate,4);
      }
    });

    // 優先度4: 宛先（〇〇御中 / 〇〇様）の直前
    const hRe=/([^\s\n　]{2,30})\s*(?:御中|様)[\s\n]/g;
    while((vm=hRe.exec(text))!==null) addVendor(vm[1],4);

    // 優先度5: (有)/(株) 略称 — 例: (有)トップシステム
    // 請求書では発行元が略称で書かれることが多く、最重要候補として扱う
    const abbr=/[（(](?:有|株|合|社)[）)]\s*([^\s\n　]{2,20})/g;
    while((vm=abbr.exec(text))!==null){
      const prefix=vm[0].match(/[（(](有|株|合|社)[）)]/)?.[1]||'';
      const name=vm[1].trim().replace(/^[_\-]+/,'');
      const expanded=prefix==='有'?`有限会社${name}`:prefix==='株'?`株式会社${name}`:vm[0];
      addVendor(expanded,5);
    }

    // 優先度3: 同一行に複数法人格がある場合、2番目以降の法人格+後続文字も候補に追加
    // 例: 「エンザントレイズ株式会社ied有限会社トッ>B」→「有限会社トッ」を候補追加
    text.split('\n').forEach(line=>{
      const t=line.trim().replace(/ /g,'').replace(/　/g,'');  // 全スペース除去
      const corpMatches=[...(t.matchAll(new RegExp(corpTypes,'g')))];
      if(corpMatches.length>=2){
        // 2番目以降の法人格の後続文字を取得
        for(let ci=1;ci<corpMatches.length;ci++){
          const cm=corpMatches[ci];
          const after=t.slice(cm.index+cm[0].length);
          // 英字・記号・ノイズを除去して残った文字を会社名候補に
          const cleaned=after.replace(/[a-zA-Z>＞\[\]|｜@#※ied]/g,'').replace(/\s/g,'').slice(0,2); // 印鑑ノイズを除くため2文字のみ
          if(cleaned.length>=1){
            addVendor(cm[0]+cleaned, 3);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // 優先度2: 行頭に会社名+法人格（後置き型）— 最初の法人格で打ち切る
    const cPost=new RegExp(`(?:^|\\n)\\s*([^\\s\\n　、。・]{1,20}(?:${corpTypes}))`,'gm');
    while((vm=cPost.exec(text))!==null){
      const raw=vm[1].trim().replace(/[>＞\[\]|｜]/g,'');
      const firstCorp=raw.match(new RegExp(`^(.+?(?:${corpTypes}))`))?.[1];
      if(firstCorp) addVendor(firstCorp,2);
    }

    // 優先度2: 法人格が前置き（株式会社〇〇）
    const cPre=new RegExp(`(?:${corpTypes})([^\\s\\n　、。・]{1,20})`,'g');
    while((vm=cPre.exec(text))!==null){
      const name=vm[1].replace(new RegExp(`(?:${corpTypes}).*`),'').trim();
      if(name.length>0){
        const corp=vm[0].match(new RegExp(`^(?:${corpTypes})`,''))?.[0]||'';
        addVendor(corp+name,2);
      }
    }

    r.vendorCands.sort((a,b)=>{
      if(b.conf!==a.conf) return b.conf-a.conf;
      // 同conf内では法人格含む名称を優先
      const aHas=new RegExp(corpTypes).test(a.val);
      const bHas=new RegExp(corpTypes).test(b.val);
      if(bHas&&!aHas) return 1;
      if(aHas&&!bHas) return -1;
      return 0;
    });
    if(r.vendorCands.length){
      const corpCand=r.vendorCands.find(v=>new RegExp(corpTypes).test(v.val));
      r.vendor=corpCand||r.vendorCands[0];
    }


    if(r.vendorCands.length){
      const corpCand=r.vendorCands.find(v=>new RegExp(corpTypes).test(v.val));
      r.vendor=corpCand||r.vendorCands[0];
    }

    // ===== 摘要 =====
    const nm=text.match(/(?:件名|品目|内容|サービス名|摘要|工事名|件)[：:\s　]*([^\n]{4,40})/);
    if(nm) r.note=nm[1].trim().slice(0,40);

    return r;
  }

  function applyField(inputId,confId,candId,matched,cands,type){
    const input=document.getElementById(inputId),confEl=document.getElementById(confId),candEl=document.getElementById(candId);
    if(matched&&matched.val){input.value=matched.val;const c=matched.conf;confEl.innerHTML=`<span class="conf-dot ${c>=3?'conf-h':c>=2?'conf-m':'conf-l'}"></span><span>${c>=3?'高信頼度':c>=2?'中信頼度':'低信頼度 — 確認推奨'}</span>`;}
    else confEl.innerHTML=`<span class="conf-dot conf-l"></span><span>抽出できませんでした</span>`;
    const others=cands.filter((_,i)=>i>0).slice(0,3);
    if(others.length) candEl.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:10px;color:#9ca3af">他の候補: </span>'+others.map(c=>`<button class="cand-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('${inputId}').value='${esc(c.val)}'">${type==='amount'?(c.disp||c.val):c.val}</button>`).join('');
  }

  /* ===== 抽出テキストの表示/非表示切り替え ===== */
  function toggleOcrBox(id, labelEl){
    const box=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!box) return;
    const willShow = box.style.display==='none';
    box.style.display = willShow ? 'block' : 'none';
    const icon = labelEl.querySelector('i');
    if(icon) icon.style.transform = willShow ? 'rotate(90deg)' : '';
    const textEl = labelEl.querySelector('.ocr-toggle-text');
    if(textEl) textEl.textContent = textEl.textContent.replace(willShow?'を表示':'を隠す', willShow?'を隠す':'を表示');
  }

  /* ===== ユーティリティ ===== */
  function buildFN(date,amount,vendor,type,ext){
    const dp=(date||'').split('-');
    const dateStr=dp.length===3 ? `${dp[0]}年${dp[1]}月${dp[2]}日` : (date||'').replace(/-/g,'');
    const amountStr=String(amount).replace(/[^\d]/g,'')+'円';
    return (type?type.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_')+'_':'')+dateStr+'_'+amountStr+'_'+vendor.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_')+'.'+(ext||'pdf');
  }
  function updateFN(dId,aId,vId,pId,tId,ext){const d=document.getElementById(dId).value,a=document.getElementById(aId).value,v=document.getElementById(vId).value,t=tId?document.getElementById(tId).value:'';document.getElementById(pId).textContent=(d&&a&&v)?buildFN(d,a,v,t,ext):'（日付・金額・取引先を入力してください）';}
  function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/'/g,"\\'");}
  function escHtml(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');}

  /* ===== 書類一覧 ===== */
  function getSearchConditions(){
    return {
      vendor:   (document.getElementById('sq-vendor')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
      assignee: (document.getElementById('sq-assignee')?.value||''),
      user:     (document.getElementById('sq-user')?.value||''),
      type:     (document.getElementById('sq-type')?.value||''),
      dateFrom: (document.getElementById('sq-date-from')?.value||''),
      dateTo:   (document.getElementById('sq-date-to')?.value||''),
      status:   (document.getElementById('sq-status')?.value||''),
      amtMin:   parseInt(document.getElementById('sq-amount-min')?.value||'')||null,
      amtMax:   parseInt(document.getElementById('sq-amount-max')?.value||'')||null,
      source:   (document.getElementById('sq-source')?.value||''),
      original: (document.getElementById('sq-original')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
      keyword:  (document.getElementById('sq-keyword')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
    };
  }

  function isSearchActive(){
    const c=getSearchConditions();
    return !!(c.vendor||c.assignee||c.user||c.type||c.dateFrom||c.dateTo||c.status||c.amtMin||c.amtMax||c.source||c.original||c.keyword);
  }

  function toggleSearchPanel(){
    const panel=document.getElementById('searchPanel');
    const chev=document.getElementById('searchPanelChevron');
    const open=panel.style.display==='none'||!panel.style.display;
    panel.style.display=open?'block':'none';
    chev.style.transform=open?'rotate(180deg)':'';
  }

  function clearSearch(){
    ['sq-vendor','sq-assignee','sq-user','sq-type','sq-date-from','sq-date-to','sq-status','sq-amount-min','sq-amount-max','sq-source','sq-original','sq-keyword']
      .forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.value='';});
    renderRecords();
  }

  function refreshSearchAssigneeSelect(){
    const el=document.getElementById('sq-assignee');
    if(!el) return;
    const cur=el.value;
    el.innerHTML='<option value="">すべて</option>'+assignees.map(a=>`<option value="${escHtml(a)}"${a===cur?' selected':''}>${escHtml(a)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function refreshSearchUserSelect(){
    const el=document.getElementById('sq-user');
    if(!el) return;
    const cur=el.value;
    el.innerHTML='<option value="">すべて</option>'+users.map(u=>`<option value="${escHtml(u)}"${u===cur?' selected':''}>${escHtml(u)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  /* ===== エクスポートページのAND検索 ===== */
  function toggleExportSearchPanel(){
    const panel=document.getElementById('exSearchPanel');
    const chev=document.getElementById('exSearchPanelChevron');
    const open=panel.style.display==='none'||!panel.style.display;
    panel.style.display=open?'block':'none';
    chev.style.transform=open?'rotate(180deg)':'';
  }

  function clearExportSearch(){
    ['ex-vendor','ex-assignee','ex-user','ex-type','ex-date-from','ex-date-to','ex-status','ex-amount-min','ex-amount-max','ex-source','ex-original','ex-keyword']
      .forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.value='';});
    renderExport();renderCompliance();
  }

  function refreshExportSelects(){
    refreshAllAssigneeSelects();
    refreshAllUserSelects();
    refreshAllDocTypeSelects();
  }

  function getExportSearchConditions(){
    return {
      vendor:   (document.getElementById('ex-vendor')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
      assignee: (document.getElementById('ex-assignee')?.value||''),
      user:     (document.getElementById('ex-user')?.value||''),
      type:     (document.getElementById('ex-type')?.value||''),
      dateFrom: (document.getElementById('ex-date-from')?.value||''),
      dateTo:   (document.getElementById('ex-date-to')?.value||''),
      status:   (document.getElementById('ex-status')?.value||''),
      amtMin:   parseInt(document.getElementById('ex-amount-min')?.value||'')||null,
      amtMax:   parseInt(document.getElementById('ex-amount-max')?.value||'')||null,
      source:   (document.getElementById('ex-source')?.value||''),
      original: (document.getElementById('ex-original')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
      keyword:  (document.getElementById('ex-keyword')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),
    };
  }

  function isExportSearchActive(){
    const c=getExportSearchConditions();
    return !!(c.vendor||c.assignee||c.user||c.type||c.dateFrom||c.dateTo||c.status||c.amtMin||c.amtMax||c.source||c.original||c.keyword);
  }

  function getExportFilteredRecords(){
    const c=getExportSearchConditions();
    const badge=document.getElementById('exSearchActiveBadge');
    if(badge) badge.style.display=isExportSearchActive()?'':'none';
    return records.filter(r=>{
      if(r.deleted) return false;
      if(c.vendor   && !r.vendor.toLowerCase().includes(c.vendor)) return false;
      if(c.assignee && r.assignee!==c.assignee) return false;
      if(c.user     && r.user!==c.user) return false;
      if(c.type     && r.type!==c.type) return false;
      if(c.dateFrom && r.date<c.dateFrom) return false;
      if(c.dateTo   && r.date>c.dateTo)  return false;
      if(c.status   && r.status!==c.status) return false;
      if(c.amtMin!==null && r.amount<c.amtMin) return false;
      if(c.amtMax!==null && r.amount>c.amtMax) return false;
      if(c.source   && r.source!==c.source) return false;
      if(c.original && !(r.originalName||'').toLowerCase().includes(c.original)) return false;
      if(c.keyword){
        const kw=c.keyword;
        const hit=r.filename.toLowerCase().includes(kw)||
                  (r.note||'').toLowerCase().includes(kw)||
                  (r.memo||'').toLowerCase().includes(kw);
        if(!hit) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }).slice().sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
  }

  function getFilteredRecords(){
    const c=getSearchConditions();
    // バッジ表示
    const badge=document.getElementById('searchActiveBadge');
    if(badge) badge.style.display=isSearchActive()?'':'none';

    return records.filter(r=>{
      // AND条件
      if(c.vendor   && !r.vendor.toLowerCase().includes(c.vendor)) return false;
      if(c.assignee && r.assignee!==c.assignee) return false;
      if(c.user     && r.user!==c.user) return false;
      if(c.type     && r.type!==c.type) return false;
      if(c.dateFrom && r.date<c.dateFrom) return false;
      if(c.dateTo   && r.date>c.dateTo)  return false;
      if(c.status   && r.status!==c.status) return false;
      if(c.amtMin!==null && r.amount<c.amtMin) return false;
      if(c.amtMax!==null && r.amount>c.amtMax) return false;
      if(c.source   && r.source!==c.source) return false;
      if(c.original && !(r.originalName||'').toLowerCase().includes(c.original)) return false;
      if(c.keyword){
        const kw=c.keyword;
        const hit=r.filename.toLowerCase().includes(kw)||
                  (r.note||'').toLowerCase().includes(kw)||
                  (r.memo||'').toLowerCase().includes(kw);
        if(!hit) return false;
      }
      // ステータスフィルター（タブ）
      const mf=activeFilter==='all'
        ||(activeFilter==='pending'&&r.status==='pending')
        ||(activeFilter==='confirmed'&&r.status==='confirmed')
        ||r.type===activeFilter;
      return mf;
    }).slice().sort((a,b)=>{
      let av,bv;
      if(sortField==='amount'){ av=a.amount||0; bv=b.amount||0; }
      else if(sortField==='status'){ av=a.deleted?'2無効':a.status==='confirmed'?'1確定済み':'0確定待ち'; bv=b.deleted?'2無効':b.status==='confirmed'?'1確定済み':'0確定待ち'; }
      else{ av=(a[sortField]||'').toString(); bv=(b[sortField]||'').toString(); }
      let cmp;
      if(typeof av==='number' && typeof bv==='number') cmp = av-bv;
      else cmp = String(av).localeCompare(String(bv), 'ja');
      return sortDir==='asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
  }

  function setSortField(field){
    if(sortField===field){ sortDir = sortDir==='asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'; }
    else{ sortField=field; sortDir = (field==='date'||field==='amount') ? 'desc' : 'asc'; }
    renderRecords();
  }

  function sortIcon(field){
    if(sortField!==field) return '<i class="ti ti-selector" style="font-size:12px;color:#c7cbd1"></i>';
    return sortDir==='asc'
      ? '<i class="ti ti-sort-ascending" style="font-size:12px;color:#4338ca"></i>'
      : '<i class="ti ti-sort-descending" style="font-size:12px;color:#4338ca"></i>';
  }

  function renderRecords(){
    const types=[...new Set(records.map(r=>r.type))];
    const pendingCnt=records.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
    const confirmedCnt=records.filter(r=>r.status==='confirmed').length;
    document.getElementById('filterRow').innerHTML=
      `<button class="filter-btn${activeFilter==='all'?' active':''}" onclick="setFilter('all')">すべて（${records.filter(r=>!r.deleted).length}）</button>`+
      `<button class="filter-btn filter-btn-pending${activeFilter==='pending'?' active':''}" onclick="setFilter('pending')" style="${activeFilter==='pending'?'background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-color:#fcd34d':'border-color:#fcd34d;color:#92400e'}">⏳ 確定待ち（${pendingCnt}）</button>`+
      `<button class="filter-btn${activeFilter==='confirmed'?' active':''}" onclick="setFilter('confirmed')" style="${activeFilter==='confirmed'?'background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46;border-color:#6ee7b7':''}">✓ 確定済み（${confirmedCnt}）</button>`+
      `<button class="filter-btn${activeFilter==='void'?' active':''}" onclick="setFilter('void')" style="${activeFilter==='void'?'background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;border-color:#cbd5e1':'color:#94a3b8'}">🚫 無効（${records.filter(r=>r.deleted).length}）</button>`+
      types.map(t=>`<button class="filter-btn${activeFilter===t?' active':''}" onclick="setFilter('${t}')">${t}</button>`).join('');

    const data=getFilteredRecords();
    const pendingInView=data.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
    const banner=document.getElementById('pendingBanner');
    if(pendingInView>0){
      banner.style.display='flex';
      document.getElementById('pendingBannerText').textContent=`${pendingInView}件の書類が確定待ちです。内容を確認してから「確定」してください。`;
    }else{banner.style.display='none';}

    const body=document.getElementById('recordsBody');
    if(!data.length){body.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-inbox"></i><p>該当する書類がありません</p></div>';return;}
    body.innerHTML=`<table class="tbl">
      <colgroup><col style="width:36px"><col style="width:78px"><col style="width:78px"><col style="width:90px"><col style="width:50px"><col style="width:78px"><col style="width:64px"><col style="width:64px"><col><col style="width:102px"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr>
        <th class="row-check"><input type="checkbox" class="row-cb" id="selectAll" onchange="toggleSelectAll(this.checked)" title="すべて選択"/></th>
        <th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('date')">取引日 ${sortIcon('date')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('amount')">金額 ${sortIcon('amount')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('vendor')">取引先 ${sortIcon('vendor')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('type')">種別 ${sortIcon('type')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('status')">ステータス ${sortIcon('status')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('assignee')">担当者 ${sortIcon('assignee')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('user')">利用者 ${sortIcon('user')}</th><th style="cursor:pointer;user-select:none" onclick="setSortField('filename')">ファイル名 ${sortIcon('filename')}</th><th></th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${data.map(r=>{
        const i=records.indexOf(r);
        const bc=r.type==='請求書'?'badge-invoice':r.type==='領収書'?'badge-receipt':r.type==='発注書（注文書）'||r.type==='発注請書（注文請書）'?'badge-order':r.type==='クラウドサイン'?'badge-cloud':'badge-other';
        const isPending=r.status==='pending';
        const statusBadge=r.deleted
          ?`<span class="badge badge-void"><i class="ti ti-ban" style="font-size:9px"></i>無効</span>`
          :isPending
          ?`<span class="badge badge-pending"><i class="ti ti-clock" style="font-size:9px"></i>確定待ち</span>`
          :`<span class="badge badge-confirmed"><i class="ti ti-circle-check" style="font-size:9px"></i>確定済み</span>`;
        const confirmBtn=isPending
          ?`<button class="btn btn-confirm btn-sm" onclick="confirmRecord(${i})"><i class="ti ti-check"></i>確定</button>`
          :`<button class="btn btn-unconfirm btn-sm" onclick="unconfirmRecord(${i})"><i class="ti ti-rotate-left"></i>戻す</button>`;
        return `<tr class="${r.deleted?'row-void':isPending?'row-pending':''}" data-idx="${i}" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openViewer(${i},event)">
          <td class="row-check" onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><input type="checkbox" class="row-cb rec-cb" data-idx="${i}" onchange="onRowCheck()"/></td>
          <td>${r.date}</td><td>¥${r.amount.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td title="${escHtml(r.vendor)}">${escHtml(r.vendor)}</td>
          <td><span class="badge ${bc}">${r.type}</span></td>
          <td>${statusBadge}</td>
          <td>${r.assignee?`<span class="assignee-tag"><i class="ti ti-user"></i>${escHtml(r.assignee)}</span>`:'<span style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:11px">—</span>'}</td>
          <td>${r.user?`<span class="assignee-tag" style="background:#e0f2fe;color:#0369a1"><i class="ti ti-user-circle"></i>${escHtml(r.user)}</span>`:'<span style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:11px">—</span>'}</td>
          <td class="mono" title="${escHtml(r.filename)}">${escHtml(r.filename)}</td>
          <td style="display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center">
            ${confirmBtn}
            <button class="action-btn" onclick="dlPdf(${i})" title="ダウンロード"><i class="ti ti-download"></i></button>
            ${r.deleted?
              `<button class="action-btn" onclick="restoreRecord(${i})" title="復元" style="color:#4338ca"><i class="ti ti-restore"></i></button>`:
              `<button class="action-btn" onclick="voidRecord(${i})" title="無効化（論理削除）" style="color:#9ca3af"><i class="ti ti-trash"></i></button>`
            }
          </td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
    updateBulkBar();
  }

  function setFilter(f){activeFilter=f;renderRecords();}

  /* チェックボックス関連 */
  function getCheckedIndices(){
    return [...document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb:checked')].map(cb=>parseInt(cb.dataset.idx));
  }

  function onRowCheck(){
    updateBulkBar();
    // ヘッダーのチェックボックス状態を同期
    const all=document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb');
    const checked=document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb:checked');
    const sa=document.getElementById('selectAll');
    if(sa){
      sa.indeterminate=checked.length>0&&checked.length<all.length;
      sa.checked=all.length>0&&checked.length===all.length;
    }
  }

  function toggleSelectAll(val){
    document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb').forEach(cb=>cb.checked=val);
    updateBulkBar();
  }

  function clearSelection(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb').forEach(cb=>cb.checked=false);
    const sa=document.getElementById('selectAll');
    if(sa){sa.checked=false;sa.indeterminate=false;}
    updateBulkBar();
  }

  function updateBulkBar(){
    const cnt=document.querySelectorAll('.rec-cb:checked').length;
    const bar=document.getElementById('bulkBar');
    const countEl=document.getElementById('bulkCount');
    if(bar) bar.classList.toggle('active',cnt>0);
    if(countEl) countEl.textContent=cnt;
  }

  async function downloadSelected(){
    const indices=getCheckedIndices();
    if(!indices.length){alert('ダウンロードする書類を選択してください');return;}
    // PDF本体が未読込のものは先に取得を試みる
    await Promise.all(indices.map(i=>records[i] && !records[i].pdfBytes ? loadPdfBytesForRecord(records[i]) : null));
    const targets=indices.filter(i=>records[i]&&records[i].pdfBytes);
    const noData=indices.length-targets.length;
    if(!targets.length){
      alert('選択した書類にダウンロード可能なPDFデータがありません。');
      return;
    }
    if(noData>0) alert(`${targets.length}件をダウンロードします。\n（${noData}件はPDFデータがないためスキップします）`);
    targets.forEach((idx,n)=>{
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const r=records[idx];
        const blob=new Blob([r.pdfBytes],{type:mimeTypeForFilename(r.filename)});
        const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a=document.createElement('a');
        a.href=url;a.download=r.filename;a.click();
        setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000);
      },n*500);
    });
  }

  /* ===== 訂正・削除履歴ヘルパー ===== */
  function addHistory(record, type, detail){
    if(!record.history) record.history=[];
    record.history.push({
      type,       // 'create'|'edit'|'status'|'void'|'restore'
      detail,     // 表示文字列
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  /* ===== 論理削除（無効化） ===== */
  async function voidRecord(i){
    if(!confirm('この書類を無効化しますか？\n書類は削除されず「無効」として記録されます。「書類一覧 → 無効」タブから確認・復元できます。')) return;
    records[i].deleted   = true;
    records[i].deletedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    addHistory(records[i], 'void', '書類を無効化（論理削除）');
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
    if(vIdx===i){ renderViewerDetail(); }
    await dbSaveRecord(records[i]);
    const h=records[i].history;
    if(h.length>0) await dbSaveHistory(records[i]._id, h[h.length-1]);
  }

  async function restoreRecord(i){
    if(!confirm('この書類を有効に戻しますか？')) return;
    records[i].deleted   = false;
    records[i].deletedAt = null;
    addHistory(records[i], 'restore', '書類を復元（無効化を取り消し）');
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
    if(vIdx===i){ renderViewerDetail(); }
    await dbSaveRecord(records[i]);
    const h=records[i].history;
    if(h.length>0) await dbSaveHistory(records[i]._id, h[h.length-1]);
  }

  function deleteSelected(){
    const indices=getCheckedIndices();
    if(!indices.length){alert('操作する書類を選択してください');return;}
    const activeRec=indices.filter(i=>!records[i].deleted);
    const voidRec=indices.filter(i=>records[i].deleted);
    if(!confirm(`選択した ${indices.length} 件を無効化しますか？
書類は削除されず「無効」として履歴に残ります。`))return;
    activeRec.forEach(i=>{
      records[i].deleted=true;
      records[i].deletedAt=new Date().toISOString();
      addHistory(records[i],'void','一括無効化');
    });
    updatePendingBadge();
    renderRecords();
  }

  function delRecord(i){
    voidRecord(i);
  }

  /* ===== ダッシュボード ===== */
  function renderDashboard(){
    const now=new Date();
    const pendingCnt=records.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
    const confirmedCnt=records.filter(r=>r.status==='confirmed').length;
    const confirmedTotal=records.filter(r=>r.status==='confirmed').reduce((s,r)=>s+r.amount,0);
    document.getElementById('d-count').textContent=records.filter(r=>!r.deleted).length;
    document.getElementById('d-total').textContent='¥'+confirmedTotal.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('d-pending').textContent=pendingCnt;
    document.getElementById('d-confirmed').textContent=confirmedCnt;
    const months=[];
    for(let i=5;i>=0;i--){const d=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()-i,1);const key=`${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;months.push({label:(d.getMonth()+1)+'月',count:records.filter(r=>r.date.startsWith(key)).length});}
    const max=Math.max(...months.map(m=>m.count),1);
    document.getElementById('bar-chart').innerHTML=months.map(m=>`<div class="bar-col"><div class="bar-val">${m.count||''}</div><div class="bar" style="height:${Math.round((m.count/max)*120)}px"></div><div class="bar-label">${m.label}</div></div>`).join('');
    const driveCnt=records.filter(r=>r.source==='drive').length,manualCnt=records.filter(r=>!r.source||r.source==='manual'||r.source==='gmail'||r.source==='auto').length;
    document.getElementById('source-legend').innerHTML=[{label:'Google Drive取込',count:driveCnt,color:'#0d9488'},{label:'手動取込',count:manualCnt,color:'#6b7280'}].map(s=>`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:#374151"><span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:${s.color};display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0"></span>${s.label}</div><strong style="font-size:13px">${s.count}件</strong></div>`).join('');
    const recent=records.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.savedAt.localeCompare(a.savedAt)).slice(0,5);
    const rb=document.getElementById('recent-body');
    if(!recent.length){rb.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><i class="ti ti-inbox"></i><p>まだ書類がありません</p></div>';return;}
    rb.innerHTML=`<table class="tbl"><colgroup><col style="width:84px"><col style="width:84px"><col style="width:106px"><col style="width:54px"><col style="width:86px"><col></colgroup><thead><tr><th>取引日</th><th>金額</th><th>取引先</th><th>種別</th><th>ステータス</th><th>ファイル名</th></tr></thead><tbody>${recent.map(r=>{const bc=r.type==='請求書'?'badge-invoice':r.type==='領収書'?'badge-receipt':'badge-other';const isPending=r.status==='pending';return`<tr class="${isPending?'row-pending':''}"><td>${r.date}</td><td>¥${r.amount.toLocaleString()}</td><td title="${escHtml(r.vendor)}">${escHtml(r.vendor)}</td><td><span class="badge ${bc}">${r.type}</span></td><td>${isPending?'<span class="badge badge-pending">確定待ち</span>':'<span class="badge badge-confirmed">確定済み</span>'}</td><td class="mono">${escHtml(r.filename)}</td></tr>`;}).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  /* ===== エクスポート ===== */
  async function dlPdf(i){const r=records[i];if(!r.pdfBytes) await loadPdfBytesForRecord(r);if(!r.pdfBytes){alert('PDFデータがありません');return;}const blob=new Blob([r.pdfBytes],{type:mimeTypeForFilename(r.filename)});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=r.filename;a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
  async function downloadAll(){
    const candidates=getExportFilteredRecords();
    await Promise.all(candidates.map(r=>!r.pdfBytes ? loadPdfBytesForRecord(r) : null));
    const dl=candidates.filter(r=>r.pdfBytes);
    if(!dl.length){alert('ダウンロード可能なPDFがありません（表示中の絞り込み条件に一致するものがないか、PDFデータがありません）');return;}
    dl.forEach((r,i)=>{const idx=records.indexOf(r);setTimeout(()=>dlPdf(idx),i*400);});
  }

    </tr></thead><tbody>${data.map(r=>{const i=records.indexOf(r);return `<tr class="${r.status==='pending'?'row-pending':''}">
      <td class="row-check"><input type="checkbox" class="row-cb export-cb" data-idx="${i}" onchange="onExportRowCheck()"/></td>
      <td>${r.date}</td><td>¥${r.amount.toLocaleString()}</td><td title="${escHtml(r.vendor)}">${escHtml(r.vendor)}</td><td>${r.status==='pending'?'<span class="badge badge-pending">確定待ち</span>':'<span class="badge badge-confirmed">確定済み</span>'}</td><td class="mono" title="${escHtml(r.filename)}">${escHtml(r.filename)}</td><td><button class="dl-btn" onclick="dlPdf(${i})"><i class="ti ti-download"></i>保存</button></td></tr>`;}).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  function getCheckedExportIndices(){
    return [...document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb:checked')].map(cb=>parseInt(cb.dataset.idx));
  }

  function onExportRowCheck(){
    updateExportBulkBar();
    const all=document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb');
    const checked=document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb:checked');
    const sa=document.getElementById('exportSelectAll');
    if(sa){
      sa.indeterminate=checked.length>0&&checked.length<all.length;
      sa.checked=all.length>0&&checked.length===all.length;
    }
  }

  function toggleExportSelectAll(val){
    document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb').forEach(cb=>cb.checked=val);
    updateExportBulkBar();
  }

  function clearExportSelection(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb').forEach(cb=>cb.checked=false);
    const sa=document.getElementById('exportSelectAll');
    if(sa){sa.checked=false;sa.indeterminate=false;}
    updateExportBulkBar();
  }

  function updateExportBulkBar(){
    const cnt=document.querySelectorAll('.export-cb:checked').length;
    const bar=document.getElementById('exportBulkBar');
    const countEl=document.getElementById('exportBulkCount');
    if(bar) bar.classList.toggle('active',cnt>0);
    if(countEl) countEl.textContent=cnt;
  }

  async function downloadSelectedExport(){
    const indices=getCheckedExportIndices();
    if(!indices.length){alert('ダウンロードする書類を選択してください');return;}
    const targets=indices.map(i=>records[i]).filter(Boolean);
    await Promise.all(targets.map(r=>!r.pdfBytes ? loadPdfBytesForRecord(r) : null));
    const dl=targets.filter(r=>r.pdfBytes);
    const noData=targets.length-dl.length;
    if(!dl.length){alert('選択した書類にダウンロード可能なPDFデータがありません。\n（Google Drive連携で取り込んだファイルは、再度Google Driveから取得を試みます）');return;}
    if(noData>0) alert(`${dl.length}件をダウンロードします。\n（${noData}件はPDFデータがないためスキップします）`);
    dl.forEach((r,n)=>{
      setTimeout(()=>{const idx=records.indexOf(r);dlPdf(idx);},n*400);
    });
  }

  function exportCSV(target='all'){
    let data=getExportFilteredRecords();
    if(target==='confirmed') data=data.filter(r=>r.status==='confirmed');
    if(!data.length){alert('該当するデータがありません');return;}
    const content='\uFEFF取引日,金額,取引先,種別,摘要,担当者,利用者,ファイル名,元ファイル名,取込元,ステータス,登録日時,確定日時,無効化,SHA-256ハッシュ\n'+data.map(r=>`${r.date},${r.amount},${r.vendor},${r.type},${r.note||''},${r.assignee||''},${r.user||''},${r.filename},${r.originalName||''},${r.source||'手動'},${r.deleted?'無効':r.status==='confirmed'?'確定済み':'確定待ち'},${r.registeredAt||r.savedAt||''},${r.confirmedAt||''},${r.deleted?r.deletedAt||'無効':''},${r.sha256||''}`).join('\n');
    const blob=new Blob([content],{type:'text/csv'});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=`denchouhou_${target}.csv`;a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function renderCompliance(){
    const data=getExportFilteredRecords();
    const confirmedCnt=data.filter(r=>r.status==='confirmed').length;
    const pendingCnt=data.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
    const items=[
      {ok:true,text:'電子データの保存対応（PDF形式）'},
      {ok:true,text:'テキストPDFからの高精度テキスト抽出'},
      {ok:true,text:'日付・金額・取引先の検索要件に対応'},
      {ok:true,text:'ファイル名規則（書類種別_年月日_金額円_取引先）に準拠'},
      {ok:confirmedCnt>0,text:`確定済み書類: ${confirmedCnt}件`},
      {ok:pendingCnt===0,text:pendingCnt===0?'確定待ち書類なし':`確定待ち書類が ${pendingCnt} 件あります`},
      {ok:true,text:'CSVエクスポートによる会計システム連携'},
      {ok:data.length>0&&data.filter(r=>r.sha256).length===data.length, text:`SHA-256ハッシュ記録: ${data.filter(r=>r.sha256).length}/${data.length}件`},
    ];
    document.getElementById('complianceList').innerHTML=items.map(i=>`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:.5px solid #f3f4f6;color:${i.ok?'#065f46':'#9ca3af'}"><i class="ti ti-${i.ok?'circle-check':'circle-dashed'}"></i>${i.text}</div>`).join('');
  }

  /* ===== 担当者マスタ ===== */
  function buildAssigneeOptions(selectedVal=''){
    const blank='<option value="">— 未選択 —</option>';
    return blank+assignees.map(a=>`<option value="${escHtml(a)}"${a===selectedVal?' selected':''}>${escHtml(a)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function buildUserOptions(selectedVal=''){
    const blank='<option value="">— 未選択 —</option>';
    return blank+users.map(u=>`<option value="${escHtml(u)}"${u===selectedVal?' selected':''}>${escHtml(u)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function refreshAllAssigneeSelects(){
    refreshSearchAssigneeSelect();
    // インポートフォーム
    ['fieldAssignee','dimp-assignee'].forEach(id=>{
      const el=document.getElementById(id);
      if(el) el.innerHTML=buildAssigneeOptions(el.value);
    });
    // 分割フォーム
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="sp-assignee-"]').forEach(el=>{
      el.innerHTML=buildAssigneeOptions(el.value);
    });
    // ビューワー
    const va=document.getElementById('vAssignee');
    if(va) va.innerHTML=buildAssigneeOptions(va.value);
    // エクスポート検索
    const exa=document.getElementById('ex-assignee');
    if(exa){const cur=exa.value;exa.innerHTML='<option value="">すべて</option>'+assignees.map(a=>`<option value="${escHtml(a)}"${a===cur?' selected':''}>${escHtml(a)}</option>`).join('');}
  }

  function refreshAllUserSelects(){
    refreshSearchUserSelect();
    // インポートフォーム
    ['fieldUser','dimp-user'].forEach(id=>{
      const el=document.getElementById(id);
      if(el) el.innerHTML=buildUserOptions(el.value);
    });
    // 分割フォーム
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="sp-user-"]').forEach(el=>{
      el.innerHTML=buildUserOptions(el.value);
    });
    // ビューワー
    const vu=document.getElementById('vUser');
    if(vu) vu.innerHTML=buildUserOptions(vu.value);
    // エクスポート検索
    const exu=document.getElementById('ex-user');
    if(exu){const cur=exu.value;exu.innerHTML='<option value="">すべて</option>'+users.map(u=>`<option value="${escHtml(u)}"${u===cur?' selected':''}>${escHtml(u)}</option>`).join('');}
  }

  /* ===== 書類種別マスタ ===== */
  function buildDocTypeOptions(selectedVal='', includeAll=false){
    const list = docTypes.length ? docTypes : DEFAULT_DOC_TYPES;
    const head = includeAll ? '<option value="">すべて</option>' : '';
    return head + list.map(t=>`<option${t===selectedVal?' selected':''}>${escHtml(t)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function refreshAllDocTypeSelects(){
    // インポートフォーム（「未選択」は無く、常にどれかが選ばれる想定）
    ['fieldType','dimp-type'].forEach(id=>{
      const el=document.getElementById(id);
      if(el) el.innerHTML=buildDocTypeOptions(el.value||docTypes[0]);
    });
    // 分割フォーム
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="sp-type-"]').forEach(el=>{
      el.innerHTML=buildDocTypeOptions(el.value||docTypes[0]);
    });
    // ビューワー
    const vt=document.getElementById('vType');
    if(vt) vt.innerHTML=buildDocTypeOptions(vt.value||docTypes[0]);
    // 検索フィルター（「すべて」を含む）
    const sqt=document.getElementById('sq-type');
    if(sqt) sqt.innerHTML=buildDocTypeOptions(sqt.value, true);
    const ext=document.getElementById('ex-type');
    if(ext) ext.innerHTML=buildDocTypeOptions(ext.value, true);
  }

  function addAssignee(){
    const input=document.getElementById('newAssigneeName');
    const name=(input.value||'').trim();
    if(!name){alert('担当者名を入力してください');return;}
    if(assignees.includes(name)){alert('すでに登録されています');return;}
    assignees.push(name);
    input.value='';
    renderAssigneeList();
    refreshAllAssigneeSelects();
    dbSaveAssignee(name);
  }

  function addUser(){
    const input=document.getElementById('newUserName');
    const name=(input.value||'').trim();
    if(!name){alert('利用者名を入力してください');return;}
    if(users.includes(name)){alert('すでに登録されています');return;}
    users.push(name);
    input.value='';
    renderUserList();
    refreshAllUserSelects();
    dbSaveUser(name);
  }

  function addDocType(){
    const input=document.getElementById('newDocTypeName');
    const name=(input.value||'').trim();
    if(!name){alert('書類種別名を入力してください');return;}
    if(docTypes.includes(name)){alert('すでに登録されています');return;}
    docTypes.push(name);
    input.value='';
    renderDocTypeList();
    refreshAllDocTypeSelects();
    dbSaveDocType(name);
  }

  function deleteAssignee(i){
    if(!confirm(`「${assignees[i]}」を削除しますか？
登録済み書類からもタグが外れます。`)) return;
    const name=assignees[i];
    assignees.splice(i,1);
    records.forEach(r=>{if(r.assignee===name)r.assignee='';});
    renderAssigneeList();
    refreshAllAssigneeSelects();
    refreshSearchAssigneeSelect();
    renderRecords();
    dbDeleteAssignee(name);
  }

  function deleteUser(i){
    if(!confirm(`「${users[i]}」を削除しますか？
登録済み書類からもタグが外れます。`)) return;
    const name=users[i];
    users.splice(i,1);
    records.forEach(r=>{if(r.user===name)r.user='';});
    renderUserList();
    refreshAllUserSelects();
    refreshSearchUserSelect();
    renderRecords();
    dbDeleteUser(name);
  }

  function deleteDocType(i){
    if(!confirm(`「${docTypes[i]}」を削除しますか？
すでにこの種別で登録済みの書類はそのまま表示され続けます（種別選択肢から無くなるだけです）。`)) return;
    const name=docTypes[i];
    docTypes.splice(i,1);
    renderDocTypeList();
    refreshAllDocTypeSelects();
    dbDeleteDocType(name);
  }

  function renderAssigneeList(){
    const el=document.getElementById('assigneeList');
    if(!el) return;
    if(!assignees.length){
      el.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af;padding:8px 0">担当者が登録されていません</div>';
      return;
    }
    el.innerHTML=assignees.map((a,i)=>`
      <div class="assignee-item" id="aitem-${i}">
        <!-- 通常表示 -->
        <div id="aview-${i}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;gap:10px">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:#111827;font-weight:500">
            <i class="ti ti-user" style="color:#6b7280;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0"></i>
            <span id="atext-${i}">${escHtml(a)}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0">
            <button class="assignee-edit-btn" onclick="startEditAssignee(${i})">
              <i class="ti ti-pencil"></i>編集
            </button>
            <button class="assignee-del-btn" onclick="deleteAssignee(${i})">
              <i class="ti ti-trash"></i>削除
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- 編集モード -->
        <div id="aedit-row-${i}" style="display:none;align-items:center;width:100%;gap:8px">
          <i class="ti ti-user" style="color:#6366f1;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0"></i>
          <input type="text" id="aedit-${i}" value="${escHtml(a)}"
            style="font-size:13px;padding:6px 10px;border:.5px solid #6366f1;border-radius:6px;outline:none;flex:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(99,102,241,.15)"
            onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')saveAssignee(${i});if(event.key==='Escape')cancelEditAssignee(${i})"/>
          <button class="assignee-save-btn" onclick="saveAssignee(${i})">
            <i class="ti ti-check"></i>保存
          </button>
          <button class="assignee-cancel-btn" onclick="cancelEditAssignee(${i})">
            <i class="ti ti-x"></i>キャンセル
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }

  function startEditAssignee(i){
    document.getElementById('aview-'+i).style.display='none';
    const editRow=document.getElementById('aedit-row-'+i);
    editRow.style.display='flex';
    document.getElementById('aedit-'+i).focus();
    document.getElementById('aedit-'+i).select();
  }

  function cancelEditAssignee(i){
    document.getElementById('aedit-'+i).value=assignees[i];
    document.getElementById('aedit-row-'+i).style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('aview-'+i).style.display='flex';
  }

  function saveAssignee(i){
    const newName=(document.getElementById('aedit-'+i).value||'').trim();
    if(!newName){alert('担当者名を入力してください');return;}
    if(assignees.includes(newName)&&assignees[i]!==newName){alert('同じ名前がすでに登録されています');return;}
    const oldName=assignees[i];
    assignees[i]=newName;
    // 登録済み書類の担当者名も更新
    records.forEach(r=>{if(r.assignee===oldName)r.assignee=newName;});
    renderAssigneeList();
    refreshAllAssigneeSelects();
    renderRecords();
    dbUpdateAssignee(oldName, newName);
  }

  function saveUser(i){
