  async function saveSettings(){
    const companyName = document.getElementById('s-company').value.trim();
    const invoiceNumber = document.getElementById('s-invoice').value.trim();
    const taxRate = document.getElementById('s-tax').value;
    const fiscalYearStart = document.getElementById('s-fy').value;

    appSettings.companyName = companyName;
    appSettings.invoiceNumber = invoiceNumber;
    appSettings.taxRate = taxRate;
    appSettings.fiscalYearStart = fiscalYearStart;

    await Promise.all([
      dbSaveSetting('companyName', companyName),
      dbSaveSetting('invoiceNumber', invoiceNumber),
      dbSaveSetting('taxRate', taxRate),
      dbSaveSetting('fiscalYearStart', fiscalYearStart),
    ]);

    renderSettingsForm();
    renderDriveScopeBanner();
    renderAssigneeList();
    renderUserList();
    renderDocTypeList();
    alert('設定を保存しました');
  }

  /* ===== ビューワー担当者・利用者 ===== */
  function vSaveAssignee(){
    if(vIdx===null) return;
    records[vIdx].assignee=document.getElementById('vAssignee').value;
    renderRecords();
    dbSaveRecord(records[vIdx]);
  }

  function vSaveUser(){
    if(vIdx===null) return;
    records[vIdx].user=document.getElementById('vUser').value;
    renderRecords();
    dbSaveRecord(records[vIdx]);
  }

  /* ===== タイムスタンプブロック描画 ===== */
  function renderViewerTimestamp(r){
    const el=document.getElementById('vTimestampBlock');
    if(!el) return;
    const fmtDate=iso=>iso?new Date(iso).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'}):'—';
    const isConfirmed=r.status==='confirmed';
    const blockClass=isConfirmed?'ts-block':'ts-block-pending';
    const statusIcon=isConfirmed?'✅ 確定済み（タイムスタンプ記録済み）':'⏳ 確定待ち（確定するとタイムスタンプが確定されます）';
    const statusColor=isConfirmed?'#065f46':'#92400e';
    const hash=r.sha256||'—';
    const hashDisp=hash!=='—'?hash.substring(0,16)+'...'+hash.substring(hash.length-8):'—';
    el.innerHTML=`
      <div class="${blockClass}">
        <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:${statusColor};margin-bottom:10px">${statusIcon}</div>
        <div class="ts-row">
          <span class="ts-label">登録日時</span>
          <span class="ts-value">${fmtDate(r.registeredAt||r.savedAt)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ts-row">
          <span class="ts-label">確定日時</span>
          <span class="ts-value" style="color:${isConfirmed?'#065f46':'#9ca3af'}">${fmtDate(r.confirmedAt)}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px">
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
            <span>SHA-256 ハッシュ値</span>
            <button onclick="copyHash('${r.sha256||''}')" style="font-size:9px;padding:1px 7px;border:.5px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;color:#4338ca">コピー</button>
            ${r.sha256?`<span style="font-size:9px;color:#065f46">✓ 改ざん検知用</span>`:''}
          </div>
          <div class="ts-hash">${hash}</div>
        </div>
        ${isConfirmed?`
        <div style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:8px;border-top:.5px solid #d1fae5">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:#6b7280">
            ※ このハッシュ値はPDFファイルまたは書類メタデータから生成されたSHA-256値です。<br>
            　 電帳法の「真実性の確保」要件における改ざん検知の参考情報としてご活用ください。<br>
            　 法的証明力を持つ公的タイムスタンプには外部TSAサービスとの契約が必要です。
          </div>
        </div>`:''}
      </div>`;
  }

  function copyHash(hash){
    if(!hash){alert('ハッシュ値がありません');return;}
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(hash).then(()=>{
      const toast=document.getElementById('savedToast');
      const orig=toast.innerHTML;
      toast.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-copy"></i>ハッシュ値をコピーしました';
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(()=>{toast.classList.remove('show');toast.innerHTML=orig;},2000);
    }).catch(()=>alert('コピー失敗: '+hash.substring(0,20)+'...'));
  }

  /* ===== 訂正・削除履歴パネル描画 ===== */
  function renderViewerHistory(r){
    const el=document.getElementById('vHistoryPanel');
    if(!el) return;
    const hist=(r.history||[]).slice().reverse();  // 新しい順
    if(!hist.length){
      el.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af">履歴はありません</div>';
      return;
    }
    const dotColor={create:'history-dot-create',edit:'history-dot-edit',status:'history-dot-status',void:'history-dot-void',restore:'history-dot-status'};
    const typeLabel={create:'登録',edit:'訂正',status:'ステータス変更',void:'無効化',restore:'復元'};
    el.innerHTML=hist.map(h=>{
      const dt=new Date(h.at).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
      return `<div class="history-item">
        <span class="history-dot ${dotColor[h.type]||'history-dot-edit'}"></span>
        <span class="history-time">${dt}</span>
        <div class="history-body">
          <span style="font-weight:600;color:#374151">${typeLabel[h.type]||h.type}</span>
          <div class="history-diff">${escHtml(h.detail)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function resetData(){records=[];updatePendingBadge();renderDashboard();alert('データをリセットしました');}

  /* ===== 書類ビューワー ===== */
  let vIdx=null, vScale=1.0, vPage=1, vNumPages=1, vPdfDoc=null;

  async function openViewer(i, e){
    // ボタン列クリックは無視
    if(e&&e.target.closest('button,input')) return;
    vIdx=i;
    vScale=1.0;
    vPage=1;
    vPdfDoc=null;
    const r=records[i];
    if(!r) return;
    document.getElementById('viewerOverlay').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
    renderViewerDetail();
    if(!r.pdfBytes && r.source!=='gmail'){
      const empty=document.getElementById('vPdfEmpty');
      const canvas=document.getElementById('vCanvas');
      if(canvas) canvas.style.display='none';
      if(empty){ empty.style.display='flex'; empty.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i><span>PDFを読み込み中...</span>'; }
      await loadPdfBytesForRecord(r);
      if(empty) empty.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-file-off"></i><span>PDFデータなし</span>';
    }
    await renderViewerPdf();
  }

  function closeViewer(e){
    if(e&&e.target!==document.getElementById('viewerOverlay')) return;
    document.getElementById('viewerOverlay').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='';
    vPdfDoc=null;
  }

  function renderViewerDetail(){
    const r=records[vIdx];
    const visibleData=getFilteredRecords();
    const visIdx=visibleData.indexOf(r);
    // ナビ
    document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent=r.filename;
    document.getElementById('vPrevBtn').disabled=visIdx<=0;
    document.getElementById('vNextBtn').disabled=visIdx>=visibleData.length-1;
    // 無効化書類の場合はバナー表示
    const voidBanner=document.getElementById('vVoidBanner');
    if(r.deleted){
      if(!voidBanner){
        const sb=document.getElementById('vStatusBadge');
        const banner=document.createElement('div');
        banner.id='vVoidBanner';
        banner.style.cssText='background:#fef2f2;border:.5px solid #fecaca;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:12px;color:#991b1b;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px';
        banner.innerHTML=`<i class="ti ti-ban"></i>この書類は無効化されています。<button onclick="restoreRecord(${vIdx})" style="margin-left:auto;background:none;border:.5px solid #fecaca;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;cursor:pointer;color:#991b1b;font-size:11px">復元する</button>`;
        sb.parentNode.insertBefore(banner,sb);
      }
    } else {
      if(voidBanner) voidBanner.remove();
    }
    // ステータス
    const isPending=r.status==='pending';
    document.getElementById('vStatusBadge').innerHTML=isPending
      ?'<span class="badge badge-pending"><i class="ti ti-clock" style="font-size:9px"></i>確定待ち</span>'
      :'<span class="badge badge-confirmed"><i class="ti ti-circle-check" style="font-size:9px"></i>確定済み</span>';
    const sa=document.getElementById('vSavedAt');
    sa.textContent=r.savedAt?'登録: '+new Date(r.savedAt).toLocaleString('ja-JP'):'';
    // 確定ボタン
    const cb=document.getElementById('vConfirmBtn');
    if(isPending){cb.className='btn btn-confirm btn-sm';cb.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-check"></i>確定する';}
    else{cb.className='btn btn-unconfirm btn-sm';cb.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-rotate-left"></i>確定解除';}
    // 編集可能フィールドに値をセット
    document.getElementById('vType').value=r.type||'請求書';
    document.getElementById('vDate').value=r.date||'';
    document.getElementById('vVendor').value=r.vendor||'';
    document.getElementById('vAmount').value=r.amount||'';
    document.getElementById('vNote').value=r.note||'';
    const srcMap={gmail:'Gmail連携',drive:'Google Drive連携',auto:'自動取込',manual:'手動取込'};
    document.getElementById('vSource').textContent=srcMap[r.source]||'手動取込';
    document.getElementById('vConfirmedAt').textContent=r.confirmedAt?new Date(r.confirmedAt).toLocaleString('ja-JP'):'—';
    document.getElementById('vFilename').textContent=r.filename||'—';
    document.getElementById('vOriginalName').textContent=r.originalName||'—';
    document.getElementById('vMemo').value=r.memo||'';
    // タイムスタンプブロック描画
    renderViewerTimestamp(r);
    // 履歴パネル描画
    renderViewerHistory(r);
    // 担当者プルダウン
    const va=document.getElementById('vAssignee');
    if(va) va.innerHTML=buildAssigneeOptions(r.assignee||'');
    // 利用者プルダウン
    const vu=document.getElementById('vUser');
    if(vu) vu.innerHTML=buildUserOptions(r.user||'');
  }

  async function renderViewerPdf(){
    const r=records[vIdx];
    const canvas=document.getElementById('vCanvas');
    const empty=document.getElementById('vPdfEmpty');
    const imgEl=document.getElementById('vImage');
    if(!r.pdfBytes){canvas.style.display='none';imgEl.style.display='none';empty.style.display='flex';document.getElementById('vPageInfo').textContent='';return;}
    const imgInfo=imageInfoFromName(r.filename||r.originalName||'');
    if(imgInfo){
      canvas.style.display='none';empty.style.display='none';
      if(imgEl._forIdx!==vIdx){
        if(imgEl._blobUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(imgEl._blobUrl);
        const blob=new Blob([r.pdfBytes],{type:imgInfo.mime});
        const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        imgEl.src=url;
        imgEl._blobUrl=url;
        imgEl._forIdx=vIdx;
      }
      imgEl.style.display='block';
      imgEl.style.transform=`scale(${vScale})`;
      imgEl.style.transformOrigin='top left';
      vNumPages=1;vPage=1;
      document.getElementById('vPageInfo').textContent='1 / 1';
      document.getElementById('vZoomLabel').textContent=Math.round(vScale*100)+'%';
      return;
    }
    imgEl.style.display='none';
    canvas.style.display='block';empty.style.display='none';
    try{
      if(!vPdfDoc){
        const buf=r.pdfBytes.buffer.slice(r.pdfBytes.byteOffset,r.pdfBytes.byteOffset+r.pdfBytes.byteLength);
        vPdfDoc=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:buf, ...PDFJS_DOC_OPTS}).promise;
        vNumPages=vPdfDoc.numPages;
        vPage=Math.min(vPage,vNumPages);
      }
      document.getElementById('vPageInfo').textContent=`${vPage} / ${vNumPages}`;
      const page=await vPdfDoc.getPage(vPage);
      const vp=page.getViewport({scale:vScale*1.8});
      canvas.width=vp.width;canvas.height=vp.height;
      await page.render({canvasContext:canvas.getContext('2d'),viewport:vp}).promise;
      document.getElementById('vZoomLabel').textContent=Math.round(vScale*100)+'%';
    }catch(err){canvas.style.display='none';empty.style.display='flex';}
  }

  async function vZoom(delta){
    vScale=Math.min(4,Math.max(0.25,vScale+delta));
    await renderViewerPdf();
  }
  async function vZoomReset(){vScale=1.0;await renderViewerPdf();}
  async function vPrevPage(){if(vPage>1){vPage--;await renderViewerPdf();}}
  async function vNextPage(){if(vPage<vNumPages){vPage++;await renderViewerPdf();}}

  function viewerNav(dir){
    const visibleData=getFilteredRecords();
    const r=records[vIdx];
    const cur=visibleData.indexOf(r);
    const next=visibleData[cur+dir];
    if(!next) return;
    vIdx=records.indexOf(next);
    vPage=1;vScale=1.0;vPdfDoc=null;
    renderViewerDetail();
    renderViewerPdf();
  }

  function vToggleConfirm(){
    if(records[vIdx].status==='pending') confirmRecord(vIdx);
    else unconfirmRecord(vIdx);
    renderViewerDetail();
  }

  async function vOpenTab(){
    const r=records[vIdx];
    if(!r.pdfBytes) await loadPdfBytesForRecord(r);
    if(!r.pdfBytes){alert('PDFデータがありません');return;}
    const blob=new Blob([r.pdfBytes],{type:mimeTypeForFilename(r.filename)});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    window.open(url,'_blank');
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000);
  }

  async function vDownload(){
    const r=records[vIdx];
    if(!r.pdfBytes) await loadPdfBytesForRecord(r);
    if(!r.pdfBytes){alert('PDFデータがありません');return;}
    const blob=new Blob([r.pdfBytes],{type:mimeTypeForFilename(r.filename)});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=r.filename;a.click();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000);
  }

  // 書類情報フィールドの変更を即時保存してリスト・バッジを更新
  let vSaveTimer=null;
  let _vFieldPrev = {};  // 変更前の値を一時保存

  function vSaveField(){
    if(vIdx===null) return;
    const r=records[vIdx];
    // 変更前の値を取得
    const prev={
      type:r.type, date:r.date, vendor:r.vendor,
      amount:r.amount, note:r.note
    };
    const newType   = document.getElementById('vType').value;
    const newDate   = document.getElementById('vDate').value;
    const newVendor = document.getElementById('vVendor').value.trim();
    const newAmount = parseInt(document.getElementById('vAmount').value.replace(/[^\d]/g,''))||0;
    const newNote   = document.getElementById('vNote').value;

    // 訂正履歴の差分を記録（変更があった項目のみ）
    const diffs=[];
    if(prev.type   !==newType)              diffs.push({label:'書類種別', old:prev.type,           nw:newType});
    if(prev.date   !==newDate)              diffs.push({label:'取引日',   old:prev.date,           nw:newDate});
    if(prev.vendor !==newVendor)            diffs.push({label:'取引先',   old:prev.vendor,         nw:newVendor});
    if(prev.amount !==newAmount)            diffs.push({label:'金額',     old:'¥'+prev.amount.toLocaleString(), nw:'¥'+newAmount.toLocaleString()});
    if((prev.note||'')!==(newNote||''))     diffs.push({label:'摘要',     old:prev.note||'（空）', nw:newNote||'（空）'});

    if(diffs.length>0){
      const detail=diffs.map(d=>`${d.label}: 「${d.old}」→「${d.nw}」`).join(' / ');
      addHistory(r,'edit',detail);
    }

    r.type   = newType;
    r.date   = newDate;
    r.vendor = newVendor;
    r.amount = newAmount;
    r.note   = newNote;

    // ファイル名を再生成（元の拡張子を保持する）
    if(r.date&&r.amount&&r.vendor){
      const keepExt=(imageInfoFromName(r.filename)||{}).ext||'pdf';
      r.filename=buildFN(r.date,r.amount,r.vendor,r.type,keepExt);
      document.getElementById('vFilename').textContent=r.filename;
      document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent=r.filename;
    }
    // トースト表示
    clearTimeout(vSaveTimer);
    const toast=document.getElementById('savedToast');
    toast.classList.add('show');
    vSaveTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),2000);
    // 履歴パネル更新
    renderViewerHistory(r);
    // 一覧も更新（遅延）
    clearTimeout(window._renderTimer);
    window._renderTimer=setTimeout(async()=>{
      renderRecords();
      // Supabaseに保存
      if(vIdx!==null) await dbSaveRecord(records[vIdx]);
    },600);
  }

  async function vTempSave(){
    if(vIdx===null) return;
    // 保留中の自動保存（デバウンス）をキャンセルし、フォームの最新値を直ちに反映
    clearTimeout(vSaveTimer);
    clearTimeout(window._renderTimer);
    vSyncFormToRecord();
    renderRecords();
    const toast=document.getElementById('savedToast');
    const orig=toast.innerHTML;
    toast.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-clock-pause"></i>一時保存中...';
    toast.classList.add('show');
    const ok = await dbSaveRecord(records[vIdx]);
    toast.innerHTML = ok
      ? '<i class="ti ti-device-floppy"></i>一時保存しました'
      : '<i class="ti ti-alert-triangle"></i>一時保存に失敗しました';
    setTimeout(()=>{toast.classList.remove('show');toast.innerHTML=orig;},2000);
  }

  // フォームの現在値をレコードへ反映するだけの内部ヘルパー（履歴記録・トースト表示はしない）
  function vSyncFormToRecord(){
    if(vIdx===null) return;
    const r=records[vIdx];
    const prev={type:r.type,date:r.date,vendor:r.vendor,amount:r.amount,note:r.note};
    const newType   = document.getElementById('vType').value;
    const newDate   = document.getElementById('vDate').value;
    const newVendor = document.getElementById('vVendor').value.trim();
    const newAmount = parseInt(document.getElementById('vAmount').value.replace(/[^\d]/g,''))||0;
    const newNote   = document.getElementById('vNote').value;

    const diffs=[];
    if(prev.type   !==newType)              diffs.push({label:'書類種別', old:prev.type,           nw:newType});
    if(prev.date   !==newDate)              diffs.push({label:'取引日',   old:prev.date,           nw:newDate});
    if(prev.vendor !==newVendor)            diffs.push({label:'取引先',   old:prev.vendor,         nw:newVendor});
    if(prev.amount !==newAmount)            diffs.push({label:'金額',     old:'¥'+prev.amount.toLocaleString(), nw:'¥'+newAmount.toLocaleString()});
    if((prev.note||'')!==(newNote||''))     diffs.push({label:'摘要',     old:prev.note||'（空）', nw:newNote||'（空）'});
    if(diffs.length>0){
      const detail=diffs.map(d=>`${d.label}: 「${d.old}」→「${d.nw}」`).join(' / ');
      addHistory(r,'edit',detail);
      renderViewerHistory(r);
    }

    r.type=newType; r.date=newDate; r.vendor=newVendor; r.amount=newAmount; r.note=newNote;
    r.memo=document.getElementById('vMemo').value;

    if(r.date&&r.amount&&r.vendor){
      const keepExt=(imageInfoFromName(r.filename)||{}).ext||'pdf';
      r.filename=buildFN(r.date,r.amount,r.vendor,r.type,keepExt);
      document.getElementById('vFilename').textContent=r.filename;
      document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent=r.filename;
    }
  }

  async function vSaveMemo(){

    await dbSaveRecord(records[vIdx]);

  /* ===== PDFプレビューのドラッグスクロール（左右上下） ===== */
  (function(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('vCanvasWrap');
    if(!wrap) return;
    let isDown=false, startX=0, startY=0, startScrollLeft=0, startScrollTop=0, moved=false;

    function beginDrag(clientX, clientY){
      isDown=true; moved=false;
      startX=clientX; startY=clientY;
      startScrollLeft=wrap.scrollLeft; startScrollTop=wrap.scrollTop;
      wrap.classList.add('dragging');
    }
    function duringDrag(clientX, clientY, evt){
      if(!isDown) return;
      const dx=clientX-startX, dy=clientY-startY;
      if(Math.abs(dx)>2||Math.abs(dy)>2) moved=true;
      wrap.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft - dx;
      wrap.scrollTop  = startScrollTop  - dy;
      if(evt&&evt.cancelable) evt.preventDefault();
    }
    function endDrag(){
      isDown=false;
      wrap.classList.remove('dragging');
    }

    // マウス操作
    wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', e=>{ beginDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY); });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{ duringDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY, e); });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', endDrag);
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{ if(!isDown) return; });

    // タッチ操作（スマホ・タブレット）
    wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', e=>{
      const t=e.touches[0]; beginDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    }, {passive:true});
    wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', e=>{
      const t=e.touches[0]; duringDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY, e);
    }, {passive:false});
    wrap.addEventListener('touchend', endDrag);
    wrap.addEventListener('touchcancel', endDrag);
  })();

  // ===== ログイン認証 =====
  async function bootApp(){
    renderDriveAuthStatus();
    const { data: userData } = await db.auth.getUser();
    const emailEl = document.getElementById('sidebarUserEmail');
    if(emailEl && userData && userData.user) emailEl.textContent = userData.user.email || '';
    try{
      await dbLoadAll();
    }catch(e){
      console.error('Supabase初期化エラー:', e);
      renderDashboard();
    }
  }

  async function doLogin(){
    const email=document.getElementById('auth-email').value.trim();
    const password=document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
    const errEl=document.getElementById('authError');
    const btn=document.getElementById('authLoginBtn');
    errEl.style.display='none';
    if(!email||!password){
      errEl.textContent='メールアドレスとパスワードを入力してください';
      errEl.style.display='block';
      return;
    }
    btn.disabled=true;btn.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-loader-2"></i>ログイン中...';
    try{
      const { error } = await db.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
      if(error){
        errEl.textContent = 'ログインに失敗しました。メールアドレスまたはパスワードが正しくありません。';
        errEl.style.display='block';
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('authOverlay').classList.remove('open');
      await bootApp();
    }catch(e){
      errEl.textContent = 'ログインエラー: '+e.message;
      errEl.style.display='block';
    }finally{
      btn.disabled=false;btn.innerHTML='<i class="ti ti-login"></i>ログイン';
    }
  }

  async function doLogout(){
    if(!confirm('ログアウトしますか？')) return;
    await db.auth.signOut();
    location.reload();
  }

  async function checkAuthAndBoot(){
    try{
      const { data } = await db.auth.getSession();
      if(data && data.session){
        document.getElementById('authOverlay').classList.remove('open');
        await bootApp();
      }else{
        document.getElementById('authOverlay').classList.add('open');
      }
    }catch(e){
      console.error('認証確認エラー:', e);
      document.getElementById('authOverlay').classList.add('open');
    }
  }

  // ===== 起動時にSupabaseからデータ読み込み =====
  checkAuthAndBoot();
